Infomineo is a pioneering global AI-enhanced research company that transforms how businesses access, analyze, and act on critical intelligence. We’ve evolved from traditional business research outsourcing to become the strategic partner that combines cutting-edge artificial intelligence with deep human expertise. We offer 3 services to our global clients (leading consulting companies, Fortune 500 companies, and government entities): AI and Data Advisory, Next-Gen Insights and Resource Scaling. Ready to kick start your career with us?

**About this role**

This role will give you the opportunity to work on high added value data governance and data quality projects, building robust data management frameworks for our clients within a growing service company.

As our Data Governance Specialist, you will help clients take control of their data assets — defining policies, enforcing quality standards, managing metadata, and deploying governance tooling. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, analysts, and client stakeholders to embed governance practices across the full data lifecycle.

**What will you do?**

Design, implement, and operationalize data governance frameworks across client engagements, covering the following areas:

**DATA GOVERNANCE & POLICY**

* Define and implement data governance frameworks, policies, and standards tailored to client environments.
* Establish data ownership, stewardship models, and accountability structures across business and technical teams.
* Develop and maintain data dictionaries, business glossaries, and classification taxonomies.
* Ensure compliance with data regulations and internal data management policies (GDPR, BCBS 239, etc.).

**DATA QUALITY & LINEAGE**

* Design and implement data quality rules, profiling routines, and monitoring dashboards.
* Investigate and remediate data quality issues across structured and unstructured data sources.
* Map and document end-to-end data lineage to support auditability and impact analysis.
* Define and track data quality KPIs and SLAs in collaboration with data owners.

**METADATA & CATALOGUING**

* Deploy and administer data catalog and metadata management tools (e.g. Informatica, Collibra, Alation, Microsoft Purview).
* Enrich metadata assets with business context, ownership, sensitivity classification, and usage information.
* Drive adoption of the data catalog across business and technical teams.

**TOOLING & INTEGRATION**

* Configure and operate data governance platforms, primarily Informatica (IDMC, Axon, EDC, DQ) and equivalent tools.
* Integrate governance tooling with existing data pipelines, warehouses, and BI environments.
* Automate data quality checks and governance workflows within ETL/ELT pipelines.

**OTHER**

* Provide internal training and knowledge-sharing sessions on data governance best practices.
* Support the Team Lead/Manager on client relationships, business development, and internal projects.

**Who are you?**

**EDUCATION & PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE**

* Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Statistics, or Applied Mathematics.
* Full proficiency in English + 1 additional language (French, Arabic, Spanish, German...).
* 3 to 6 years of experience in data governance, data management, or data engineering with a strong governance focus.
* Experience working in a consulting, financial services, or multi-client environment is a plus.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

**DATA GOVERNANCE TOOLS**

* Proven hands-on experience with Informatica (IDMC / Intelligent Data Management Cloud, Axon Data Governance, Enterprise Data Catalog, Data Quality).
* Experience with other governance and cataloguing platforms such as Collibra, Alation, Ataccama, or Microsoft Purview.
* Familiarity with data quality tools: Great Expectations, Monte Carlo, Soda, or equivalent.

**DATA ENGINEERING & QUERYING**

* Solid experience with SQL for data profiling, querying, and quality rule implementation across relational databases and data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Synapse, Redshift).
* Experience in Python for automating data quality checks, metadata extraction, and governance workflows.
* Understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines and ability to embed governance controls within them (dbt, Airflow, Informatica PowerCenter/IDMC).

**DATA ARCHITECTURE & PLATFORMS**

* Good understanding of data platform architectures: data lake, lakehouse, and data warehouse environments.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and their native governance services: Azure Purview, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Google Dataplex.
* Understanding of data modelling concepts and their impact on governance (dimensional modelling, data vault, etc.).

**STANDARDS & COMPLIANCE**

* Knowledge of data governance frameworks and standards: DAMA-DMBOK, BCBS 239, GDPR, ISO 8000.
* Experience defining and applying data classification schemes (sensitivity labels, PII tagging, retention policies).
* Exposure to master data management (MDM) concepts and tools is a plus.

**INTERPERSONAL SKILLS**

* Ability to engage and influence both technical teams and business stakeholders on data governance topics.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to diagnose data quality issues and translate them into actionable remediation plans.
* Good communication skills with the ability to document governance frameworks clearly and present findings to senior audiences.
* Detail-oriented, rigorous, and comfortable working across multiple client contexts simultaneously.

**What we offer**

* A competitive salary.
* A great working environment.
* A steep learning curve with interesting and diverse topics to work on.
* A healthy work-life balance.
* Health insurance benefits.

**Equal opportunity employer**

Infomineo is an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any sort of discrimination (based on color, race, sex, sexual orientation, religion, national origin or any other attributes) in all aspects of employment (recruiting, hiring, wages and salary, promotions, benefits, training and job termination).

If you believe you match our requirements and values, we would be happy to hear from you. Visit our website to know more about us, our services and company culture.

title: Junior Front-End Software Engineer
details:
As an engineer at Bask you will work directly with the CEO and CTO to build and design the software infrastructure that will serve as the backbone of telehealth.

We are looking to expand our software engineers, seeking those with deep rooted entrepreneurial spirit.

Our serverless platform is a multi-tenant monorepo — Next.js and React on the front, tRPC and Prisma behind it, deployed on SST, TypeScript throughout. One engineer can follow a change from a form field to the database without crossing a team boundary. That's the point.

Engineering at Bask Health is AI-first and builder-led. Work starts with general understanding of problem, moves to tools like Claude and Cursor for further investigation, making a plan and building, tested on staging with realistic data, released to production, tested with real patient and care teams, and then back for systems and polish. AI is a default part of how we work, not a side experiment — because moving fast in healthcare requires every advantage.

We are looking for engineers who take end-to-end ownership, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building software that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered.

**What You'll Do**

* **Design, build, and ship high-quality product experiences.** Own key surfaces end to end, from concept through production. Write elegant, well-tested code — we have a real test suite and we intend to keep it that way.
* **Work across the stack.** Follow a feature from the interface through the API to the database. No handoffs, no waiting on another team.
* **Work AI-first with Cursor and Claude Code.** Use LLMs as your starting point. Draft intent, explore implementations, scaffold components, and refactor with AI in the loop. Apply your own judgment to meet the quality bar healthcare demands.
* **Prototype fast and validate with real users.** Build and test quickly with real patients and care teams. Use what you learn to refine before fully committing — especially in sensitive clinical contexts where getting it right matters.
* **Build for scale and own the codebase.** Translate product needs into reusable, well-architected patterns that make the next feature faster to ship.
* **Make automation legible and trustworthy.** Build systems that clearly communicate what AI and automation are doing on behalf of patients and providers. Earn trust through transparency, reliability, and thoughtful defaults.
* **Champion performance, accessibility, and reliability.** Ship work that is fast, robust, and accessible. Partner across the team to debug, optimize, and raise the bar over time.
* **Share AI-native workflows.** Document prompts, patterns, and workflows that work, so we move faster together without cutting corners that matter to patient outcomes.

We are a highly collaborative team.

 **Requirements**

A full-stack generalist who has taken a product from 0 to 1 and can apply that instinct inside a system that already has real patients on it. Entrepreneurial, willing to roll up their sleeves, and drawn to a mission that disrupts how healthcare gets delivered.

* 1+ Years of experience
* You are a highly skilled dev (React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind and JavaScript).
* You also have backend skills (tRPC, Drizzle ORM, SQL, Node, SST).
* You can work independently and are comfortable owning entire projects or large areas of the codebase.
* Strong experience building paid products and services is preferred.
* React Native or Expo experience is a plus.
* You are a strong communicator, able to clearly articulate technical problems, constraints, and timelines.
* You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, unstructured, startup environment.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web.
  
Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com  
  
Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data.
  
Learn more about Keet: keet.io

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication.

  

* Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications.
* Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar).
* Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code.
* Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications.
* Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems.
* Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes).
* Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication.
* Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management.
* Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc).
* Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: Technical Author
details:
**Technical Author**

  

**Location**

Alexandria, Egypt (Hybrid / Remote)

This role is primarily based in Alexandria, Egypt, with significant remote working. The successful candidate will be expected to collaborate regularly with international product, engineering, security, and customer-facing teams across multiple time zones.

Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, customer engagements, training, or company events.

**Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Technical Author to create and maintain high-quality customer-facing documentation for our cybersecurity and compliance platform. The successful candidate will work closely with product managers, software engineers, security specialists, compliance experts, and customer success teams to produce clear, accurate, and accessible documentation that enables customers to deploy, configure, operate, and troubleshoot our products effectively.

The role requires the ability to understand complex technical concepts and translate them into concise documentation suitable for technical and non-technical audiences.

In addition to traditional documentation, the successful candidate will help shape modern customer enablement materials, including AI-assisted content, video-based learning resources, and knowledge assets that support intelligent customer support systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Documentation Development**

* Create, maintain, and improve product documentation, including:
  + User guides
  + Administrator guides
  + Installation and deployment guides
  + Configuration documentation
  + API documentation
  + Troubleshooting guides
  + Release notes
  + Knowledge base articles

  

**Technical Content Creation**

* Translate complex cybersecurity and compliance concepts into clear, understandable documentation.
* Produce documentation for cloud, on-premise, and hybrid deployments.
* Create workflow diagrams, architecture illustrations, and process documentation where appropriate.
* Develop onboarding materials for new customers.
* Create documentation that supports both human users and AI-powered support systems.
* Develop instructional and educational content in multiple formats, including written guides, interactive content, and video-based materials.

  

**Product Collaboration**

* Work closely with development teams to understand new features and product changes.
* Participate in sprint reviews, planning sessions, and product demonstrations.
* Collaborate with product managers to ensure documentation aligns with product functionality and customer requirements.
* Gather information directly from subject matter experts.
* Contribute to release readiness activities by ensuring documentation is delivered alongside product releases.

  

**Documentation Management**

* Maintain documentation standards, templates, style guides, and publication processes.
* Ensure documentation remains accurate and up to date following product releases.
* Manage documentation repositories and version control processes.
* Track documentation issues and improvement opportunities.
* Promote documentation-as-code practices and continuous improvement of documentation workflows.

  

**Customer Focus**

* Work with customer success and support teams to identify common customer challenges.
* Analyse support tickets and customer feedback to improve documentation effectiveness.
* Create self-service content that reduces support demand and improves customer adoption.
* Optimise content for use within customer knowledge bases and AI-assisted support platforms.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

**Essential**

* Proven experience as a Technical Author, Technical Writer, Documentation Specialist, or similar role.
* Experience producing customer-facing software documentation.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to understand complex technical systems and explain them clearly to different audiences.
* Experience working closely with software development teams.
* Strong interviewing and information-gathering skills.
* Experience managing multiple documentation projects simultaneously.

  

**Documentation Technologies**

Experience with one or more of the following:

* Git
* Markdown
* Documentation-as-Code workflows
* Static site generators
* Documentation portals
* Confluence or similar collaboration platforms
* Version control and pull request processes

  

**Technical Knowledge**

The candidate should have experience with, or the ability to rapidly learn, concepts including:

* Cybersecurity principles
* Identity and access management
* Authentication and authorisation
* Network security
* Security monitoring and logging
* Vulnerability management
* Risk management
* Compliance and governance requirements
* Cloud and SaaS platforms
* APIs and system integrations

  

**Desirable Skills and Experience**

**Cybersecurity and Compliance**

* Experience working within cybersecurity, governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), or related software environments.
* Familiarity with security standards and frameworks such as:
  + ISO 27001
  + SOC 2
  + NIST Cybersecurity Framework
  + CIS Controls
  + PCI DSS
* Experience documenting SaaS, cloud-native, or enterprise software platforms.

  

**Technical Skills**

* Experience documenting APIs and integrations.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, YAML, and command-line interfaces.
* Understanding of cloud infrastructure and container technologies.
* Experience creating technical diagrams and architecture documentation.
* Familiarity with tools such as Draw.io, Lucidchart, Visio, or equivalent.

  

**AI and Emerging Technologies**

The following experience would be advantageous:

* Experience using AI-assisted content creation tools.
* Experience creating training, onboarding, or explainer content using AI-powered video generation platforms.
* Experience scripting, producing, or managing short-form instructional videos and product walkthroughs.
* Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and their application in customer support and knowledge management.
* Experience contributing documentation and content used to train, evaluate, or improve AI-powered support assistants and chatbots.
* Familiarity with knowledge-base design, content structuring, and metadata practices that improve AI search and retrieval performance.
* Experience evaluating the effectiveness of AI-driven customer support solutions.

  

**Personal Attributes**

* Exceptional written communication skills.
* Curious, analytical, and technically minded.
* Customer-focused with a commitment to producing documentation that delivers measurable value.
* Able to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Comfortable collaborating across distributed international teams.
* Organised and capable of managing competing priorities.
* Enthusiastic about learning new technologies and tools.

  

**Typical Deliverables**

The Technical Author will be expected to produce:

* Product Overview Guides
* Installation and Deployment Guides
* User Administration Guides
* Security Configuration Guides
* Compliance Mapping Guides
* API Reference Documentation
* Integration Guides
* Troubleshooting Knowledge Base Articles
* Release Notes
* Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
* AI-generated product demonstration videos
* Customer onboarding video content
* Interactive product walkthroughs
* Content optimised for AI-powered support assistants
* Knowledge articles designed for retrieval by RAG-based support systems
* Documentation supporting AI chatbot training and validation

  

**Success Measures**

Success in the role will be measured through:

* Documentation quality and accuracy.
* Timeliness of documentation delivery alongside product releases.
* Documentation coverage of product features and functionality.
* Reduction in customer support requests.
* Customer satisfaction with documentation.
* Adoption and usage metrics for documentation resources.
* Effectiveness of knowledge content used by AI-powered support systems.
* Quality and engagement metrics for video and interactive learning content.

  

**Qualifications**

**Essential**

* Degree-level qualification or equivalent professional experience.
* Demonstrable portfolio of technical documentation.

  

**Desirable**

* Technical writing certification.
* Cybersecurity certification or relevant industry experience.
* Experience working in regulated or compliance-focused industries.

  

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate combines excellent technical writing skills with a strong interest in cybersecurity, compliance, and modern customer enablement technologies. They are comfortable working in a remote-first environment, collaborating with international teams, and leveraging innovative tools—including AI-generated media and intelligent support systems—to improve customer understanding, self-service capability, and product adoption.

The candidate should be equally comfortable interviewing software engineers about a new feature, producing customer-facing documentation, creating short instructional videos, and structuring content so that it can be effectively consumed by both customers and AI-powered support assistants.

title: PYTHON INTEGRATION ENGINEER
details:

title: Junior Risk & Delivery Analyst
details:
**About the Role**

This is a deliberate growth role — one that Synapse Analytics is building from the ground up to develop a specialist at the intersection of client delivery, risk policy, and AI-powered financial analysis. As a Junior Risk & Delivery Analyst, you will sit within the Delivery & Success team and work directly under the Senior Risk Analysis SME, gaining structured, hands-on exposure to both project delivery and the analytical world of banking credit and risk policy.

On one side of this role, you will learn to translate client credit and risk policies into structured configurations within Konan — Synapse's proprietary AI decision-making platform — building the technical fluency to turn a bank's underwriting logic into a working, testable implementation. On the other side, you will support the delivery and coordination work that keeps client engagements running smoothly: organising workstreams, tracking progress, preparing materials, and keeping internal and client stakeholders aligned.

Over time, you will grow into someone who can sit in a client workshop, understand a risk policy discussion, translate it into a Konan implementation, and communicate the implications back to both technical and business audiences. We are not hiring for what you know today — we are hiring for your ability to learn, think critically, and grow into a rare hybrid profile that does not exist off the shelf.

**What You Will Do**

**Konan Policy Configuration & Implementation**

* Learn Konan's platform architecture, decision engine logic, and configuration framework under the direct guidance of the Senior Risk Analysis SME.
* Translate client credit and risk policies — including scorecards, decision trees, eligibility rules, and workflow logic — into structured Konan configurations.
* Work closely with the SME to validate that implemented policies accurately reflect client intent and perform as expected under test scenarios.
* Maintain clear, version-controlled documentation of all policy configurations, changes, and rationale for each client implementation.
* Participate in client policy workshops and implementation reviews, progressively taking on more active roles as your Konan fluency develops.

**Risk & Banking Domain Learning**

* Develop a working understanding of credit risk fundamentals, risk policy frameworks, and the role of decision engines in banking and lending operations — guided by the Senior Risk Analysis SME.
* Study client policy documents, underwriting guidelines, and risk frameworks to build the contextual knowledge needed to implement them accurately in Konan.
* Support the SME in preparing analytical inputs, client-facing insights, and consultation materials derived from Konan's outputs.
* Gradually contribute to risk consultation discussions with clients, building the confidence and knowledge to participate as a credible voice over time.

**Delivery Support & Project Coordination**

* Support the delivery of client engagements by maintaining project trackers, preparing meeting agendas and minutes, managing action item logs, and coordinating follow-ups across internal teams.
* Help keep multiple concurrent client workstreams organised and on track, flagging risks or delays to the relevant PM or SME promptly.
* Prepare structured client-facing materials including status updates, implementation summaries, and configuration documentation.
* Coordinate logistics for client calls and working sessions, ensuring the right people, materials, and context are in place ahead of every engagement.

**Internal Collaboration & Communication**

* Work closely with Project Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and the Senior Risk SME to ensure Konan implementations are aligned with both client expectations and Synapse's technical delivery standards.
* Communicate clearly and consistently across internal teams — translating between the risk/policy world and the delivery/technical world as your cross-functional understanding deepens.
* Document learnings, reusable configuration patterns, and process improvements as you grow in the role, contributing to Synapse's internal knowledge base.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are not looking for a finished product. We are looking for raw ingredients: intellectual curiosity, structured thinking, genuine enthusiasm for learning, and the discipline to grow into a role that is still being defined. The right candidate does not need to know what a scorecard is on day one — they need to be the kind of person who, once shown, will not stop until they understand it completely.

**Background & Experience**

* 0–2 years of professional experience in a structured, analytical, or client-facing role — this could include internships, graduate programmes, or early-career positions in consulting, banking, finance, technology delivery, or data analysis.
* A degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative or analytical discipline is preferred, but we care more about how you think than what you studied.
* Any prior exposure to banking, lending, credit, or risk — even academic or through internships — is a meaningful advantage.

**Critical Thinking & Analytical Ability**

* Demonstrably strong analytical and logical thinking skills — comfortable breaking down complex documents, rules, or processes into structured, implementable components.
* Ability to read a dense policy or rule-based document and extract its underlying logic accurately and completely.
* Attention to detail that borders on obsessive — policy implementation errors have real downstream consequences, and this role demands precision.
* A natural problem-solver who asks good questions, checks their own assumptions, and does not stop at a surface-level understanding.

**Organisation & Work Ethic**

* Highly organised and self-disciplined; able to manage multiple tasks, track their own progress, and meet commitments without constant supervision.
* Eager to learn and comfortable with ambiguity — this role will evolve as you grow, and the right person should find that exciting rather than unsettling.
* Takes initiative: identifies what needs to be done and does it, rather than waiting to be told.

**Communication Skills**

* Full professional fluency in both English and Arabic (written and spoken) — mandatory.
* Clear, concise written communication; able to produce well-structured notes, summaries, and documentation.
* Comfortable in client-facing settings — not necessarily as the lead, but present, engaged, and articulate.

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with decision engine concepts, rule-based systems, or business process logic — even from academic projects or personal curiosity.
* Prior experience using project management or collaboration tools (Notion, Jira, Asana, or similar).
* Exposure to data analysis tools such as Excel (advanced), SQL, or Python — not required, but a strong signal of analytical inclination.
* Interest in AI and its applications in financial services.

title: Senior IT Support Engineer
details:

* Experience managing **ISP links and telecom providers**.
* Experience in helpdesk and network support roles, including familiarity with ticketing and remote support tools.
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting and documentation skills.

Preferred

* Experience in the insurance or financial services sector.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
details:
### **Who is Awaed?**

Awaed Alosool Capital was established as a closed joint-stock company. The first Saudi platform for trading without commission. It operates under the Commercial Registration Number (7025411732) and has obtained a CMA license on March 21, 2023, to engage in dealing and asset management activities.

### **What is the role?**

We run a regulated trading platform on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure: managed Kubernetes across non-production and production environments, GitOps delivery, an API gateway in front of every public endpoint, and a market-data path that has to stay up while trading hours are open.  
You will own that platform end to end alongside a small infrastructure team: design it, automate it, keep it available during market hours, and make it defensible to auditors and pen-testers. This is a hands-on senior role with real architectural ownership, not a ticket queue.

### **What are we looking for?**

* 6+ years in DevOps, SRE, platform or cloud engineering, including production ownership of a business-critical system.
* Deep Kubernetes: not just deploying to it, but debugging it (networking, DNS, scheduling, resource pressure, etc..).
* Terraform in anger: modules, state, drift, multi-environment layouts.
* Strong Linux and networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, routing, conntrack, packet capture. You can tell a client problem from a network problem from an app problem.
* Docker and Helm, plus a CI/CD system you have owned rather than just used (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
* Scripting and automation in Python and Bash.
* Observability practice: instrumenting services, designing dashboards, writing alert rules.
* Operating stateful services in production: at least one relational database (PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQL Server), one NoSQL store, one cache (Redis), and one message broker or streaming platform (Kafka, Pulsar, RabbitMQ).
* Secrets management and IAM in a cloud environment (Vault or an equivalent).
* Comfort leading an incident: calm, communicative, writes the RCA afterwards.

### **What will you do?**

**Platform and infrastructure**

* Design, build and scale multi-region cloud environments (compute, networking, OKE, load balancers, object storage, etc..).
* Manage everything as code in Terraform: no console-only changes, reviewed via pull request.
* Run production-grade Kubernetes: node pools, upgrades, network policy, autoscaling, ingress, workload identity.

**Delivery**

* Build and maintain CI/CD with Jenkins and GitOps (ArgoCD), Helm charts, and promotion paths that a developer can self-serve.
* Ship with zero downtime: rolling, blue/green and canary strategies.
* Automate the manual: Python, Bash, Go.

**Reliability**

* Own monitoring, logging and alerting end to end (Prometheus-compatible metrics, Grafana, logs). Alerts should mean something, and page someone who can act.
* Define SLIs/SLOs for trading-critical paths: order ingestion, market data, auth, payments.
* Lead incident response, run root cause analysis, and write postmortems that produce follow-up work rather than blame.
* Own backup and disaster recovery, and prove it with restore drills.

**Security and compliance**

* Integrate SAST, DAST, dependency and image scanning into the pipelines.
* Run secrets management and IAM: least privilege, short-lived credentials, no long-lived keys in repos.
* Harden Linux and Windows fleets, drive patching and remediate pen-test findings to closure.
* Keep infrastructure evidence-ready for CMA, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 style reviews.

**Cost**

* Track cloud spend per environment and service, and turn waste into an actionable backlog.

### **Nice to have:**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and OKE. Strong AWS or GCP background transfers well and we will help you convert.
* Fintech, trading or other latency-sensitive, regulated systems.
* API gateway operations at scale (Apache APISIX, Kong, Envoy) including OIDC/JWT at the edge.
* GitOps with ArgoCD or Flux.
* Cloudflare: WAF, Zero Trust access, tunnels, DNS.
* eBPF-based networking (Cilium), service mesh, or low-latency tuning.
* Event-driven architecture.
* Configuration management (Ansible) for the non-containerised fleet.

### **How we work?**

* Infrastructure changes land through pull requests and GitOps, not through the console.
* Production access is audited and time-bound.
* We run a formal on-call rotation aligned with markets trading hours, with documented SLAs and a published escalation path.
* Every significant incident gets a written RCA and follow-up tickets.

### **Why you'll love working at Awaed?**

* Hybrid work model.
* Highly competitive salary.
* Marriage Leave.
* A flexible, fast-moving environment working with modern technologies
* Be part of a mission-driven fintech shaping the future of trading in the Gulf.
* Work with modern technologies and a talented team that values innovation and impact.

###### **Awaed is not for everyone; succeeding here requires adaptability, ownership, and a continuous drive to learn and improve.**

title: SaaS Technical Support Engineer
details:
SaaS Technical Support Engineer

**Specialisms: Cybersecurity, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), and Kubernetes**

**Job Title:** SaaS Technical Support Engineer  
**Department:** Technical Support  
**Location:** Egypt, Alexandria, Remote, Hybrid  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Contractor  
**Reports To:** Chief Techincal Officer

About the Role

We are looking for a technically capable and customer-focused SaaS Technical Support Engineer to support the delivery and operation of our software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform.

You will be responsible for investigating technical issues, assisting customers with platform configuration and integration, troubleshooting application and infrastructure problems, and working closely with our software development and engineering teams to resolve complex incidents.

The ideal candidate will have a strong technical foundation, excellent problem-solving skills, and experience supporting cloud-based applications. Experience in cybersecurity, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), or Kubernetes-based environments would be particularly advantageous.

This role offers an opportunity to work across application support, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and compliance-related technologies. You will help customers get the most from our platform while contributing to its reliability, usability, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Support and Troubleshooting

* Provide technical support to customers using our SaaS platform, investigating and resolving incidents and service requests.
* Diagnose application, configuration, authentication, connectivity, and integration issues.
* Troubleshoot issues using application logs, system metrics, diagnostic tools, and other technical resources.
* Reproduce reported problems and work with the development team to identify root causes and implement fixes.
* Manage support tickets, prioritise issues according to their severity and business impact, and keep customers informed of progress.
* Escalate complex technical issues appropriately and coordinate their resolution with internal engineering teams.
* Assist customers with platform configuration, onboarding, upgrades, and general technical queries.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-base articles.

2. SaaS Platform Operations

* Support the reliable operation and availability of our SaaS platform.
* Monitor application health, investigate performance issues, and identify potential service disruptions.
* Assist with incident management, root-cause analysis, and the implementation of preventative measures.
* Support customer integrations with external systems, APIs, identity providers, and other business applications.
* Investigate issues involving databases, web applications, network connectivity, and operating systems.
* Assist with software releases, configuration changes, and customer environment updates where required.
* Identify recurring support issues and recommend improvements to the platform, operational processes, and customer experience.

3. Cybersecurity and GRC Support

* Assist customers with technical questions relating to cybersecurity, security controls, and governance, risk, and compliance processes.
* Help customers configure and troubleshoot security-related platform features.
* Support investigations involving authentication, authorisation, access controls, and audit logging.
* Assist with technical aspects of customer security assessments, compliance requirements, and platform security questionnaires.
* Understand common cybersecurity frameworks and standards, such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and CIS Controls.
* Help customers understand how platform functionality supports their security and compliance objectives.
* Identify potential security issues and escalate them through the appropriate internal processes.
* Contribute to security documentation, technical guidance, and responses to customer security queries.

Note: This is a technical support role, not a dedicated security analyst or GRC consultant position. The successful candidate should be comfortable working with security-related concepts and willing to develop their knowledge of relevant frameworks and compliance requirements.

4. Cloud-Native Infrastructure and Kubernetes

* Assist with troubleshooting applications deployed in containerised environments.
* Investigate issues involving application containers, deployments, services, configuration, and resource utilisation.
* Use Kubernetes tools and commands to investigate pod failures, deployment issues, service connectivity, and application logs.
* Assist with diagnosing issues involving container images, environment variables, secrets, persistent storage, and network connectivity.
* Understand the relationship between application behaviour and the underlying infrastructure.
* Work with engineering teams to investigate infrastructure-related incidents and improve platform reliability.
* Develop an understanding of deployment processes, monitoring, logging, and cloud-native application architecture.

5. Customer Communication and Continuous Improvement

* Communicate technical information clearly to customers with varying levels of technical expertise.
* Provide regular updates during investigations, explaining the nature of issues and the steps being taken to resolve them.
* Set appropriate expectations regarding incident resolution times and escalation.
* Build and maintain positive customer relationships through responsive and professional support.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer onboarding, documentation, support processes, and platform usability.
* Share technical knowledge with colleagues and contribute to the development of internal support capabilities.

Essential Skills and Experience

The successful candidate will demonstrate most of the following:

* Experience in a technical support, application support, systems administration, DevOps support, or similar technical role.
* Experience troubleshooting web applications, SaaS platforms, or client-server systems.
* A good understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, TCP/IP, and general networking principles.
* Familiarity with Linux environments and command-line troubleshooting.
* Experience investigating application logs and diagnosing technical problems systematically.
* An understanding of databases and SQL, including the ability to investigate data-related issues.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and API-based integrations.
* An understanding of authentication and authorisation concepts, including role-based access control.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate unfamiliar technical issues independently.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* The ability to manage multiple support requests, prioritise effectively, and work collaboratively with technical and non-technical colleagues.
* A customer-focused approach and a commitment to providing high-quality technical support.

Desirable Skills and Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be particularly valuable.

Cybersecurity and GRC

* Experience supporting cybersecurity products, security platforms, or compliance-related SaaS applications.
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-series publications, CIS Controls, or similar security frameworks.
* An understanding of security controls, risk assessments, control testing, and compliance reporting.
* Familiarity with vulnerability management, security assessments, audit processes, or security monitoring.
* Knowledge of identity and access management, single sign-on (SSO), OAuth 2.0, or OpenID Connect (OIDC).
* Relevant qualifications such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity, or other security-related certifications.

Kubernetes and Cloud-Native Technologies

* Practical experience using Kubernetes to deploy, operate, or troubleshoot applications.
* Familiarity with Docker or other container technologies.
* Experience with Helm charts and Kubernetes application deployments.
* Understanding of Kubernetes networking, services, ingress, persistent volumes, and secrets.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with container registries, CI/CD pipelines, or infrastructure monitoring.

Development and Automation

* Basic scripting experience using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or a similar language.
* Familiarity with Git and source-control workflows.
* Experience investigating application issues using source code, stack traces, or debugging tools.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools and software deployment processes.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who:

* **Enjoys solving technical problems:** You approach incidents methodically and investigate their underlying causes rather than relying solely on workarounds.
* **Is comfortable learning:** You can quickly develop an understanding of unfamiliar technologies, products, and customer environments.

details:

This is not purely a pipeline-development role. It is a hybrid Azure DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, and Production Operations role.

The candidate is expected to manage the full deployment lifecycle—from provisioning infrastructure and automating deployments to monitoring production systems, resolving incidents, and continuously improving reliability and security.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
details:
Requirements and responsibilities

  

**About the Role**
------------------

Flairstech is looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to join our infrastructure and security team. This role spans our production AWS and Kubernetes platform end to end — starting with the CI/CD pipelines our engineering teams rely on every day, and extending to infrastructure hardening, upgrades, and monitoring across the systems that run our core procurement application. You'll take on real, current work: closing security findings from our latest infrastructure review, modernizing components that are past end-of-support, and building the guardrails (monitoring, scanning, IaC coverage) that keep that kind of drift from recurring.

You'll partner closely with engineering teams supporting a mixed technology stack — modern Spring Boot services, a legacy Java/Scala tier, and Python-based data and AI workloads — so comfort moving between cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and application-adjacent debugging is more valuable here than depth in any single narrow tool.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**CI/CD & Release Engineering**

* Build, maintain, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines that our engineering teams rely on daily to build, test, and release software.
* Act as the go-to CI/CD resource for engineering teams — triaging pipeline failures, unblocking releases, and rolling out pipeline improvements across services.
* Support release processes for a mix of JVM-based services (Java, Scala/Play, Spring Boot) and Python services, including deployment automation and rollback tooling.
* Plan and execute upgrades of end-of-life or unsupported components (runtimes, frameworks, Lambda runtimes, database engines) with minimal production disruption.

**Cloud Infrastructure & AWS**

* Manage and harden AWS infrastructure across multiple accounts/environments (VPC networking, IAM, KMS, RDS, Lambda, ElastiCache).
* Remediate network and access exposures (security groups, public accessibility, VPC segmentation) and prevent recurrence through guardrails.
* Maintain and extend Terraform-managed infrastructure; close gaps where critical resources (e.g., RDS/EKS versions) aren't yet tracked in code.

**Kubernetes & Containers**

* Operate and upgrade our production EKS clusters, including core add-ons (VPC CNI, CoreDNS, kube-proxy) and Helm-deployed workloads.
* Manage container image pipelines: ECR repositories, image scanning, tag immutability, and cross-account image distribution.

The role combines hands-on cloud engineering, automation, and operational ownership, covering environment management, monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, and continuous improvement. Working closely with Cloud SRE, Cloud Automation, Architects, and vendors, the role uses Infrastructure as Code, scripting, and cloud-native automation to reduce manual effort, improve resilience, and operate cloud services effectively at scale.

  
  

**YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Cloud Environment Administration & Management: Perform hands-on administration and operational management of cloud infrastructure and platform services, including configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, resource management, access-related operational activities, and implementation of approved changes. Ensure cloud resources remain operationally healthy, appropriately configured, supported, and aligned with defined platform, security, and architecture standards.

* Cloud Automation: Design, develop, and maintain automation for cloud operational activities using Infrastructure as Code, scripting, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native automation capabilities. Automate repetitive administration, configuration, remediation, monitoring, and maintenance activities to reduce manual intervention, improve consistency, and increase operational efficiency. Collaborate with the Cloud Automation team on reusable automation patterns, standards, pipelines, and platform-level capabilities.

* Infrastructure as Code & Configuration Management: Use and maintain Infrastructure as Code and configuration management practices for cloud infrastructure changes and operational activities. Contribute to Terraform modules, automation scripts, pipelines, and reusable operational components, ensuring changes are version-controlled, repeatable, tested, and deployed through established engineering processes

* Cloud Monitoring & Performance Management: Use tools such as Dynatrace, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and other observability capabilities to proactively identify performance, capacity, availability, and reliability issues. Takes ownership of follow-up actions, ensuring resolution is coordinated with appropriate authority and accountability.

Perform technical troubleshooting and remediation, coordinates post-incident reviews, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented. Identify recurring issues that can be eliminated through automation, architecture improvements, or changes to operational processes

* Vendor cloud operations oversight: Collaborate with Cloud SRE and as a team they act as the primary contact for vendor-managed cloud services. Ensure service delivery meets contractual obligations, including SLAs, SLRs, and performance KPIs.

* Monthly operations review: Participate in structured reviews with vendors, focusing on root cause analysis, completed or pending service requests, and operational improvement proposals.

* Cross-functional collaboration: Engage with technical and business stakeholders to align cloud operations with project timelines, technical requirements, and business priorities.

* Monitoring & Observability: Experience with Dynatrace, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, ServiceNow, and related observability capabilities. Able to interpret operational telemetry, identify trends and abnormal behavior, and translate findings into technical remediation or service improvements.

* Incident & Vendor Management: Skilled in managing complex incidents, technical escalations, root cause analysis, and service providers while maintaining ownership of the technical outcome and agreed operational KPIs.

* Automation-First Mindset: Ability to identify repetitive or error-prone operational activities and convert them into standardized and automated solutions, reducing manual effort and improving reliability.

Our cyber security practice operates nationally, and serves clients holistically with strategy, risk and governance advice, and with deep technical implementation and assurance expertise.

**Cloud Security - Configuration Review, core responsibility**  
**overview:**

* It involves examining the settings, configurations, and policies used in the IT environment, identifying potential security gaps and vulnerabilities, and recommending best practices to improve the security posture of the organization. The assets in scope can be (Network appliances, security appliances and popular operating systems such as Microsoft windows, Unix, and Linux), the reviewer is expected to look into configurations, setting as well as the man made rules such as firewall rules or access lists to check for any deviations.

  **Configuration review process:**
* Validate the Scope: Confirm and validate the scope of the assessment, including the systems and devices to be reviewed, the types of configuration settings to be assessed, and any specific security policies and standards that apply.
* Prepare the Assessment Criteria or checklist: Develop assessment criteria and checklist based on vendor best practices, industry standards and applicable client policies and procedures. The standards can include frameworks such as CIS Controls or NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
* Conduct the Assessment: Conduct the assessment, reviewing the configurations of systems and devices against the assessment criteria. This can be done using automated tools, manual review, or a combination of both.
* Identify Findings: Identify any findings or deviations from the assessment criteria. This can include misconfigurations, missing patches, or insecure settings.
* Analyze Findings: Analyze the findings to determine their impact on the security posture of the organization. Prioritize the findings based on the risk they pose to the organization.
* Develop Recommendations: Develop recommendations for remediation of the findings, including specific actions to be taken and timelines for completion.
* Present Findings and Recommendations: Present the findings and recommendations to key stakeholders in the organization.

Overall, a configuration review assessment involves a thorough review of configurations against established criteria and checklist to identify potential security risks and develop recommendations for remediation.

title: Senior Computer Vision Engineer

title: Network Lead
details:
**Job Description:**

**Job Purpose:**
----------------

  

**The Network & Network Security Lead will play a major role in ensuring the integrity, performance, and security of the organization’s networking environment. This role goes beyond operations, demanding an expert-level understanding of complex network and security architectures, a hands-on ability to troubleshoot high-impact issues, and the capability to lead cross-functional teams in delivering secure and resilient infrastructure for a regulated financial environment.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  

**Key Responsibilities & Duties:**
----------------------------------

* Architecture & Design Leadership:

* Lead the design and evolution of enterprise network and security architecture aligned with business and compliance requirements.

* Ensure integration of network security principles in all architectural decisions.

* Collaborate with the design & architect team for the new project or new initiative

* Advanced Troubleshooting & Problem Resolution:

* Own and resolve high-severity incidents by diving deep into Layer 1–7 issues spanning networking, firewalls, routing, DNS, proxies, and cloud networking.

* Lead root cause analysis and implement long-term preventive measures.

* Multiskilling & Cross-Functional Expertise:

* Provide mentorship across routing, switching, firewalls (NGFW), load balancers, VPNs, SD-WAN, ACI, SD-Access, and network access control (NAC).

* Encourage skill development across multiple technology domains within the team.

* Security Posture & Threat Management:

* Implement and maintain network segmentation, access control, and zero-trust strategies.

* Collaborate with the cross-departmental teams on incident response and threat mitigation.

* Operations Oversight & Optimization:

* Oversee the performance, availability, and efficiency of the network and its security services.

* Develop and enforce network operations procedures, ensuring compliance with industry and regulatory standards.

* Project Leadership:

* Lead critical infrastructure projects, including migrations, upgrades, and partner connectivity.

* Coordinate cross-departmentally to ensure secure rollout of new services and systems.

* Vendor & Contract Management:

* Evaluate, select, and manage vendors and service providers.

* Ensure SLA compliance and conduct regular performance reviews.

* Compliance & Audit Readiness:

* Maintain documentation and policies to meet the requirements of financial sector audits and compliance checks (e.g., PCI-DSS, ISO 27001).

* Monitoring & Incident Detection:

* Experience with proactive monitoring for performance and threats using tools like SIEM, NMS, and flow analysis.

* Define thresholds, alerts, and escalation workflows for operational and security incidents.

* Team Development:

* Provide coaching, conduct regular performance reviews, and build development plans for team members.

* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous learning.

* Documentation:

* Strong experience using documentation tools (Microsoft Office 365, Visio, Lucid chart).

* Ensure all documentation aligns with compliance, audit, and organization standards.

* Strong presentation skills.

  

Skills & Qualifications:

* Typically, 7+ years of relevant work experience in industry, with a minimum of 3 years in a similar role

* Deep hands-on expertise in enterprise networking, SDN solutions, network security, and firewall administration (Cisco, Aruba, Fortinet, Palo Alto, etc.).

* Full-stack network knowledge (routing, switching, DNS, VPN, proxies, load balancers, SD-WAN, NAC, Wi-Fi, ACI, SD-Access).

* Strong experience designing and managing secure, scalable, and high-performance networks.

* Proficient in troubleshooting complex multi-vendor, multi-layer issues under pressure.

* Understanding of secure cloud networking (Azure/AWS) and hybrid environments.

* Familiar with compliance frameworks such as Cybersecurity Framework, NCA, ISO 27001, NIST.

  

**Education & Certifications:**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Network Engineering, or a related field.

* Preferred certifications:

* Cisco CCIE (DC, Enterprise, Security) preferred Enterprise.

* **CISSP / CISM** (a plus for security leadership)

* Cloud certifications (AWS/Azure Network Specialty)

**Working Conditions:**
-----------------------

* Based in Saudi Arabia with on-site visits to data centers and site offices.

* Availability for critical incidents and changes outside of normal working hours.

* Hybrid collaboration with global teams, regulators, and auditors.

  

**Platform Proficiency (Required)**
-----------------------------------

* SolarWinds NPM (performance monitoring), NTA (traffic analysis), NCM (configuration governance — golden baselines, drift detection, scheduled backups, rollback)

* Dynatrace with Davis AI for full-stack observability and AIOps-driven root cause analysis

* Bridge AIOps for event correlation and alert noise reduction

* ServiceNow as the system of record for all ITSM workflows (incidents, changes, CMDB, approval gates)

* Palo Alto NGFW and Cisco ASA/FTD for firewall administration

* Cisco ISE for Network Access Control (posture, guest, BYOD workflows)

* Cisco SD-WAN (controller-based) with MPLS underlay across all sites

* Citrix NetScaler for load balancing (diagnostic-first approach)

  

**Delivery Model Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Lead the on-site KSA network team (Network Tower Lead/Architect + L3 engineer) while overseeing 24×7 offshore NOC teams (Egypt & India) responsible for monitoring, incident response, and change execution.

* Coordinate with ISPs for MPLS/Internet underlay circuit management.

* Ensure bilingual (Arabic and English) communication across all network touchpoints.

* Port flap triage (approval-gated port bounce via ServiceNow)

* AP recovery and client rebalancing (controller-based recovery, RF adjustment)

* BGP neighbor failure diagnostics (routing state collection, ISP escalation)

* Pre-meeting wireless readiness validation for VIP areas

* Automation pattern: SolarWinds events ServiceNow workflows Ansible playbooks

---------------------------

* NCA (National Cybersecurity Authority) — Saudi regulatory framework

* NDMO (National Data Management Office) — Saudi data governance

* ISO 27001, NIST, CIS hardening baselines

title: Senior Backend Engineer
details:
**About the Company**
=====================

**Boost** is a global platform that powers FMCG manufacturers and last-mile distribution networks with radically easy technology and growth services.

Boost’s Platform-as-a-Service offering includes:

* WhatsApp ordering to grow sales and serve more retailers with less effort;
* An offline-enabled sales app for sales reps to manage their customers;
* A fully-featured fulfilment platform with end-to-end visibility; and
* Digital payment and credit solutions in partnership with Mastercard.

We are currently scaling across markets and channels through strategic partnerships with Unilever and Mastercard, with more in the pipeline.

**About the Role**
------------------

**Boost** is searching for exceptional candidates to level up our backend engineering team. We’re looking for individuals who are equally motivated by crafting Pythonic code as they are by creating delightful user experiences.

You’ll join a small, high-performing team building commerce and fintech products for the FMCG sector, working directly with experienced co-founders across Africa and beyond.

This is a unique opportunity to join an incredible team in a purpose-driven startup!

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

Your job, in collaboration with others in the product and engineering teams, will be to write elegant, performant, and well-tested code that improves our products in meaningful ways.

You will be expected to contribute to features, bug fixes, tests, and infrastructure code alike, through both software and systems engineering. Internally, you will also be a crucial link between Boost country teams and the thousands of informal sector retailers served by our customers in order to upskill internal teams’ technical knowledge of the product.

This role reports to Boost’s Chief Technology Officer (CTO).

* **Write elegant, performant, and well-tested code**

  You will work side-by-side with the product and engineering teams to ship new—and improve existing—code:

  + Work to understand the wider purpose of each feature you work on.
  + Define, communicate, and execute on a clear plan for your work, while ensuring any unclear expectations are clarified.
  + Scope larger features down into smaller, actionable items of work.
  + Strive to reduce technical debt and communicate larger refactors.
  + Support the work of your peers through pairing, reviewing, and mentoring.
  + Prepare clean and well-written pull requests, and help to ship your work.
  + Actively participate in broader engineering efforts.
  + Raise the bar for customer experience!
* **Enable the engineering team to make better decisions**

  We work in a collaborative way—and as a member of the Platform team, you will be in one of the best positions to promote collaboration, learning, and prioritisation across teams.

  + Contribute to the Platform roadmap and prioritisation.
  + Work closely with in-country product teams to better understand product requests and ensure requirements are well written and understood.

**What You Have**
-----------------

* 5+ years’ experience in a relevant field
* A deep knowledge of Python and the ability to write clear and Pythonic code.
* Strong AI expertise and an AI-first mindset, with the judgment to know when to guide closely and when to delegate.
* Experience working with relational databases and SQL (any dialect is fine, but we work with PostgreSQL).
* Experience working with cloud infrastructure (we use AWS).
* Relevant experience in a similar role, preferably within a fast-growing startup.
* Openness to others’ ideas with a shared desire to understand and communicate the purpose of the work.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* Keen, bright, and your superpower is curiosity.
* Comfortable in a fast-paced environment and with a passion for learning from and delighting customers
* Someone with an engineering, mathematical, or scientific background.
* Someone who supports the work of their peers through pair programming, reviewing, and mentoring.
* Someone who adjusts well to shifting priorities when necessary.
* Someone who loves to share what they’re learning and working remotely.
* Someone who is a great communicator and loves to build bridges between people with different backgrounds and cultures—and in different locations.
* Motivated by our mission, resonates with our virtues and principles, and ambitious to grow into a larger future role.

**Boost virtues**
-----------------

These virtues should strongly resonate with you and are the foundations of the company we will build together:

* **Be purpose-driven:** You should be motivated by the potential to enable informal retailers to thrive in the digital economy.
* **Be tenacious:** When faced with adversity, you relentlessly persevere until you find a solution.
* **Be compassionate:** You are able to empathise with others to feel their pain and then take actionable steps to deliver solutions that alleviate it.
* **Be whole:** You live to work and achieve results, but you take care of your well-being.
* **Be good:** You are always your honest, authentic self who does the right thing, even when under pressure.

The EHS Engineer will partner closely with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, R&D, and Contractors to identify workplace hazards, assess employee exposure risks, implement effective controls, improve environmental performance, and maintain a safe and compliant workplace.  
  

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

Global Operations: Ensuring excellence in execution—from procurement to supply chain and reliability—delivering quality, safety, efficiency and sustainability across the value chain

You will join a collaborative, supportive, knowledgeable, and highly engaged team that is passionate about safety, sustainability, and continuous improvement.

Safety Leadership & Culture

* Support Safety Committee initiatives and action plans.
Drive continuous improvement of site safety performance.
