title: Senior Contracts Engineer / Administrator
details:
*Asante Gold Corporation is a gold producer with mining operations and development projects in Ghana, driven by a vision to become the preferred Tier-1 mining company in West Africa.*

*Through our Bibiani and Chirano Gold Mines, as well as the Kubi Gold Project, we are building a safe, efficient and responsible mining business that delivers meaningful and sustainable value to our employees, communities, shareholders and other stakeholders.*

*At Asante Gold, our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to creating an environment where employees can perform meaningful work, develop their careers and contribute to the future of mining in Ghana. Our culture is guided by the values of Safety, Ownership, Teamwork and Continuous Improvement.*

*We seek individuals who demonstrate accountability, collaboration, integrity and a passion for excellence.*

*If you share our ambition and are looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a dynamic and growing organization, we invite suitably qualified candidates to apply for the following position*.

***About This Role***

To provide operational, technical-commercial and contractual oversight of mining, processing, engineering and maintenance contracts at Chirano Gold Mine, ensuring that contracted services, equipment, materials and deliverables are procured and administered in accordance with approved scopes, contractual terms, budgets, operational requirements and company governance standards.

The role will serve as an independent operational contract-control function, ensuring that contractor performance, costs, variations, claims, invoices and contractual obligations are properly monitored, verified and controlled throughout the contract lifecycle.

The position will work closely with Supply Chain, Finance, Legal and departmental managers to maximise value for money, improve contractor accountability, mitigate commercial and operational risks, and prevent unauthorized expenditure and contractual leakage.

***Key Responsibilities***

**1. Contract Strategy and Scope Development**

* + Work with departmental managers to develop clear, measurable and commercially sound scopes of work for operational contracts.
  + Ensure scopes define deliverables, service levels, equipment specifications, staffing requirements, productivity expectations, schedules, exclusions and acceptance criteria.
  + Review existing contracts to identify opportunities for cost optimisation, scope rationalisation, improved productivity and reduced operational risk.
  + Support the development of contract strategies, including the assessment of owner-operated versus contractor-operated options, equipment ownership versus rental, and alternative commercial models.
  + Ensure contract requirements are aligned with approved operating plans, budgets, forecasts and capital or operating expenditure approvals.
  + Maintain a forward-looking contract register covering expiry dates, renewal requirements, notice periods, rate reviews and procurement lead times.

**2. Tendering and Commercial Evaluation**

* + Work with Supply Chain and the relevant technical departments to prepare tender documentation, commercial schedules and evaluation criteria.
  + Review tender submissions for completeness, commercial compliance, pricing assumptions, exclusions, qualifications and contractual risks.
  + Conduct or support detailed commercial evaluations, including normalisation of bids to a common scope and identification of lifecycle costs.
  + Assess proposed rates, productivity assumptions, equipment availability, labour costs, mobilisation and demobilisation, fuel, maintenance, consumables, standby charges and other cost components, as applicable.
  + Benchmark rates against comparable contracts, relevant market information and historical site costs where reliable data is available.
  + Identify commercial risks, pricing gaps, potential cost escalation and areas requiring clarification or negotiation.
  + Prepare clear commercial evaluation reports and recommendations for approval through established procurement and delegated-authority processes.
  + Ensure tender evaluations are supported by documented evidence and that procurement decisions follow approved company procedures.

**3. Contract Administration and Governance**

* + Administer assigned contracts from award and mobilisation through execution, performance review, renewal and close-out.
  + Maintain complete and current contract files, including signed agreements, amendments, approved scopes, pricing schedules, insurance documents, performance records and correspondence.
  + Monitor compliance with contractual terms, deliverables, payment conditions, service levels, warranties, notice periods and other obligations.
  + Ensure purchase orders, approved budgets and contractual commitments are aligned before work commences, in accordance with company procedures.
  + Monitor contract expiry dates and initiate renewal, re-tendering or close-out processes sufficiently in advance.
  + Ensure all amendments, extensions, rate adjustments and changes in scope are formally assessed, justified and approved before implementation, except where an authorised emergency process applies.
  + Maintain an auditable record of contractual decisions, approvals, commitments, risks and outstanding actions.
  + Escalate actual or potential contractual breaches, unauthorised commitments and governance deviations to the Operations Manager and relevant control functions.

**4.Cost Control and Commercial Assurance**

* + Establish and maintain contract cost trackers for all assigned contracts, covering approved contract values, purchase orders, actual expenditure, commitments, forecasts and remaining contract balances.
  + Monitor expenditure against approved budgets and identify emerging cost overruns, adverse trends and unplanned commitments.
  + Review contractor invoices and payment claims against contractual rates, verified quantities, approved work records, equipment utilisation, service delivery and applicable supporting documentation.
  + Reconcile contractor claims with operational records, timesheets, equipment logs, work orders, shift reports, maintenance records and other relevant evidence.
  + Identify duplicate billing, unsupported charges, unapproved standby time, excessive equipment hours, incorrect rates, unexplained productivity losses and other potential commercial leakage.
  + Track cost performance against budget, forecast, unit rates and agreed productivity measures.
  + Support Finance and departmental managers in forecasting contract expenditure and incorporating material changes into operating forecasts.
  + Identify and quantify savings opportunities, cost avoidance measures and improvements in contract value.
  + Prepare recommendations for corrective action where contract expenditure or commercial performance deviates from expectations.

**5. Contractor Performance Management**

* + Establish contract-specific key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level measures in collaboration with the relevant departmental managers.
  + Monitor contractor performance against agreed production, productivity, availability, reliability, quality, maintenance, schedule, cost and service-delivery targets.
  + Coordinate regular contract performance reviews with contractors and responsible internal stakeholders.
  + Ensure contractor performance data is supported by reliable operational records and is consistently measured against contractual requirements.
  + Track corrective actions, outstanding deliverables, recurring failures and improvement commitments to closure.
  + Identify underperformance, assess contractual remedies and recommend improvement plans, deductions, service credits, penalties or other actions where permitted by the contract.
  + Assess contractor resource adequacy, equipment availability, workforce capability and mobilisation readiness against approved requirements.
  + Escalate persistent underperformance and recommend contract restructuring, replacement, termination or re-tendering where justified and authorised

**6. Variations, Claims and Dispute Management**

* + Review requests for variations, extensions of time, additional resources, rate adjustments, standby charges and other contractual changes.
  + Verify the contractual basis, operational necessity, scope impact, cost implications and schedule implications of each request.
  + Ensure variations are supported by a clear business justification, cost estimate, budget confirmation and the required approvals.
  + Challenge unsupported claims, duplicated costs, unsubstantiated productivity assumptions and charges arising from contractor inefficiencies where the contract permits.
  + Maintain a variation and claims register recording the status, value, supporting evidence, approval status and potential exposure of each item.
  + Coordinate with Legal, Supply Chain, Finance and the relevant departmental manager on complex claims, disputes, contractual interpretation and settlement recommendations.
  + Ensure contractual notices and responses are issued within the time limits specified in the agreement.
  + Prevent retrospective approval of avoidable costs and ensure emergency changes follow approved escalation and documentation procedures

**7. Mobilisation, Execution and Demobilisation**

* + Coordinate with the relevant departments to verify contractor readiness before mobilisation.
  + Confirm that contractual prerequisites are satisfied, including approved documentation, personnel, equipment, insurance, license, permits, training and site-access requirements, as applicable.
  + Verify that mobilisation and demobilisation charges are consistent with contractual provisions and approved commercial terms.
  + Monitor delivery against mobilisation schedules and readiness milestones.
  + Ensure equipment and personnel deployed by contractors meet the agreed technical, operational and HSE requirements.
  + Coordinate contract close-out, including final account reconciliation, outstanding claims, asset return, defect resolution, documentation and lessons learned.

**8.Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* + Prepare monthly contract performance reports for the Operations Manager, highlighting expenditure, budget variance, contractor performance, variations, claims, risks and improvement opportunities.
  + Maintain a consolidated dashboard covering contract values, expenditure, commitments, forecast final cost, expiry dates, KPIs and outstanding commercial issues.
  + Provide early warning of contracts approaching expiry, budget limits or critical operational milestones.
  + Develop and maintain standard procedures, templates, checklists and registers for consistent contract administration across the Operations function.
  + Conduct periodic reviews of high-value and high-risk contracts to identify commercial exposure and opportunities for improvement.
  + Capture lessons learned from contract execution, claims, procurement outcomes and contractor performance to improve future contracting decisions.
  + Support budget preparation, business planning, operational reviews and cost-reduction initiatives with accurate contract data and commercial analysis.

***Education, Work Experience & Key Competencies***

* Bachelor's degree in Mining or a related discipline from a recognized tertiary institution.
* Professional contract management qualification or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 8 years of contract administration and commercial management experience.
* Relevant experience in contract engineering, contract administration or commercial management within a mining, mineral-processing, heavy-industrial or similarly complex operating environment.
* Demonstrate experience managing service contracts, equipment hire agreements, maintenance contracts or mining contractor agreements.
* Strong understanding of contract pricing, cost control, variations, claims, invoicing and contractor performance management.
* Experience analysing commercial proposals, budgets, expenditure and operational performance data.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and contract reporting tools.
* Excellent interpersonal, planning and organizational skills with a proven ability to build collaborative working relationships and operate effectively within cross-functional teams.

title: Senior Commissioning Site Engineer
details:

  Project Manager.

* Resposible for proper performance of tests and commissioning of the equipment supplied under the terms of the contract, in accordance with the time and work schedule drawn up by the Site Works Manager / Coordinator or Project Manager.

title: Production Associate Manager
details:
### **Job Description**

  

Kraft Heinz is looking for a Process Engineer Associate Manager who is accountable for safe, compliant, and efficient daily production operations in their assigned area. This role drives safety culture, product quality, cost and service targets, continuous improvement, and delivery of new-line projects in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders (EHS, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Engineering and external suppliers). The Process Engineer Associate Manager is a people leader who develops capabilities, enforces standards, and ensures sustained operational excellence.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

  

* Own and promote a zero-harm culture in the area; ensure all team members follow Kraft Heinz EHS standards, local regulations, and site procedures.
* Coordinate with EHS to prepare and approve risk assessments and method statements for routine and project activities; ensure LOTO, permits, and mandatory controls are in place before work starts.
* Lead incident investigations for events in the area, ensure corrective actions are implemented, and verify effectiveness.
* Deliver and track area-level EHS risk assessment, operational control, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Deliver and track area-level EHS training and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Own area-level quality KPIs, conduct root-cause analysis for quality deviations, and lead corrective/preventive actions to prevent recurrence.
* Ensure product quality and food safety standards (HACCP, GMP, site QMS) are met for all production in the area.
* Coordinate with Quality and Microbiology teams on validations, product changeovers, and any corrective actions impacting customer requirements.
* Close out any incident reporting raised during operation, maintenance, or installation activities and ensure appropriate corrective actions are taken.
* Plan, schedule, and execute production to meet customer service, cost, and inventory targets while maximizing capacity and minimizing waste.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Maintenance, Quality, Supply Chain) to resolve process issues and optimize resource utilization.
* Monitor and improve operational KPIs including OEE, throughput, downtime, yield/waste, changeover time, and labor efficiency.
* Lead daily operations management (shift handovers, Gemba, daily performance reviews, visual management) and rapid problem resolution through KHMS methodology and DMS.
* Ensure adherence to SOPs and best operational practices across shifts and production areas.
* Collaborate with Maintenance to support preventive and predictive maintenance strategies that sustain equipment reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.
* Provide technical support in troubleshooting, process validation, and performance optimization.
* Facilitate root cause analysis using 5 Whys and Fishbone tools to address recurring issues.
* Lead cross-functional improvement projects targeting cost reduction, productivity, and quality enhancement.
* Engage teams in Gemba walks, daily performance reviews, and visual management to sustain a culture of improvement.
* Drive standardization, training, and empowerment to strengthen problem-solving capabilities at all levels.
* Coach and develop operators and technicians in Lean practices and operational discipline.
* Foster teamwork, ownership, and accountability through transparent communication and performance feedback.
* Support succession planning and skill development for future operational excellence leaders.
  

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree (Engineering: Mechanical, Electrical or industry field)
* At least 7 years of experience in the same filed – preferable in FMCG
* Safety practices and principles related to maintenance activities
* Corrective and Preventive Maintenance
* Excellent Command of both Spoken and written Arabic and English
  

  

**Location(s)**
---------------

6 October Factory

title: IT-Projektmanager (m/w/d) – 100% Remote – Deutsch fließend
details:
Jede Hausverwaltung, die zu uns wechselt, hat bisher anders gearbeitet: mit einem alten Verwaltungsprogramm, Ordnern voller Dokumente, einer Telefonanlage und ein paar Excel-Listen. Du sorgst dafür, dass sie gut bei uns ankommt.

Du führst neue Kunden durch die Einführung unserer Software. Du planst den Umstieg, richtest alles mit dem Kunden ein, schulst sein Team und bleibst Ansprechpartner, bis alles läuft. Dafür brauchst du einen technischen Hintergrund, zum Beispiel als Systemadministrator, IT-Consultant oder IT-Projektmanager. Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Cloud-Diensten, und wenn sich etwas automatisieren lässt, schreibst du dir mit Claude Code selbst ein Skript dafür.

Unsere Kunden sind Hausverwaltungen in Deutschland, deshalb ist fließendes Deutsch für diese Stelle Pflicht. Du arbeitest komplett remote aus deinem Land.

**Über uns**

hausverwalter.ai ist Software für Hausverwaltungen in Deutschland. Inbox, CRM, Dokumente, Telefonie, Videocalls, Team-Chat und KI-Agenten in einer Plattform, damit Hausverwalter ihre tägliche Arbeit an einem Ort erledigen. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit Sitz in Worms und arbeiten komplett remote. Wir finanzieren uns selbst und sind profitabel.

**Was du bei uns machst**

* **Du planst die Einführung.** Mit dem Kunden legst du fest, was wann umgestellt wird, und sorgst dafür, dass der Zeitplan hält.
* **Du richtest die Software ein.** Postfächer, Telefonie, Teams, Rechte, Vorlagen und KI-Agenten: Du stellst alles so ein, dass es zur Arbeitsweise des Kunden passt.
* **Du begleitest den Datenumzug.** Du klärst mit dem Kunden, welche Daten mitkommen, arbeitest mit unseren internen Umzugs-Tools und prüfst mit ihm, ob alles richtig angekommen ist. Was sich wiederholt, automatisierst du mit eigenen Skripten.
* **Du schulst das Team des Kunden.** Per Videocall zeigst du, wie man mit der Software arbeitet, und beantwortest Fragen.
* **Du bist fester Ansprechpartner.** Per Videocall, Telefon und Chat, vom ersten Gespräch, bis der Kunde selbstständig mit der Software arbeitet.
* **Du automatisierst deine eigene Arbeit.** Mit Claude Code schreibst du dir Skripte für Einrichtung, Import und Prüfung, damit die nächste Einführung schneller geht.
* **Du bringst Kundenwünsche ins Produkt.** Was Kunden fehlt oder sie stört, gibst du an unser Team weiter.

**Beispiele, woran du arbeiten könntest**

* Eine Hausverwaltung mit acht Mitarbeitern stellt um. Du machst einen Plan für vier Wochen, richtest Postfächer und Telefonie ein, schulst das Team in zwei Calls und bist in der ersten Woche nach dem Start täglich für Fragen da.
* Ein Kunde möchte, dass Anfragen von Mietern automatisch beim richtigen Kollegen landen. Du richtest die Regeln und KI-Agenten dafür ein und testest sie mit ihm.
* Ein Kunde kommt aus einem System, das wir noch nicht kennen. Du schaust dir Export oder Schnittstelle an, klärst mit ihm, welche Daten er braucht, und baust dir mit Claude Code ein Skript für den Import.

**Gehalt**

* 1.500 bis 3.000 $ pro Monat brutto, mit Luft nach oben in den nächsten Monaten und Jahren
* Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in deinem Wohnland über unseren Partner Deel (EOR)
* Vollzeit und feste Anstellung, keine Freelancer oder Contractors

**Benefits**

* 100 % remote
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten
* Selbst finanziert und profitabel, kein Investorengeld, das verbrannt werden muss
* Kleines Team, was du baust, geht live
* Schnelle Entscheidungen, keine unnötigen Meetings und keine Freigabeschleifen

**Unser Gesundheitsprogramm**

* Einzelzimmer im Krankenhaus, weltweiter Schutz
* Freie Arzt- und Facharztwahl, keine Gesundheitsprüfung, Vorerkrankungen spielen keine Rolle
* Partner und Kinder sind mitversichert
* Operationen, Krebsbehandlung, MRT/CT/PET und Diagnostik voll abgedeckt
* Zahnbehandlung und Zahn-OP zu 90 % abgedeckt
* 675 $ pro Jahr für Physiotherapie, Osteopathie, Chiropraktik und Akupunktur
* 100 $ Krankenhaustagegeld pro Nacht, bis zu 20 Nächte
* Medikamente, Impfungen, Brillen/Kontaktlinsen, häusliche Pflege und Krankentransport abgedeckt

**Voraussetzungen**

* Fließendes Deutsch (mindestens C1), du kannst mit Kunden telefonieren und schreiben
* Gutes Englisch
* Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT, zum Beispiel als Systemadministrator, IT-Consultant oder IT-Projektmanager
* Erfahrung mit Cloud-Diensten, zum Beispiel Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Azure oder AWS
* Du schreibst dir selbst Skripte, zum Beispiel in PowerShell, Bash oder Python, um Aufgaben zu automatisieren
* Du arbeitest mit Claude Code oder ähnlichen KI-Tools, oder willst genau das lernen

**Worauf wir achten**

* Du redest gern mit Kunden und erklärst Dinge so, dass sie jeder versteht.
* Du bleibst geduldig, auch wenn ein Kunde zum dritten Mal fragt.
* Du arbeitest genau und strukturiert und behältst mehrere Kunden gleichzeitig im Blick.

* Du automatisierst eine Aufgabe lieber, als sie zweimal von Hand zu machen.
* Du arbeitest selbstständig und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Kunden.

**Schön zu haben**

* Erfahrung in der Immobilien- oder Hausverwaltungsbranche
* Erfahrung mit Datenübernahmen oder der Einführung von Software bei Kunden
* Erfahrung mit Telefonanlagen, E-Mail-Servern oder Schnittstellen (APIs)

**Die Stelle passt nicht zu dir, wenn**

* du lieber allein an Aufgaben arbeitest und nicht mit Kunden sprichst
* dir Telefonate und Videocalls unangenehm sind
* du dich nicht gern in neue Technik reinarbeitest

**So stellen wir ein**

* Kennenlerngespräch
* Interview mit unserem Gründer über deinen Werdegang

* Angebot

Mehr über das, was wir bauen, siehst du auf unserem YouTube-Kanal.

title: Junior Technical Project Manager (Konan & Doxter)
details:
**About Synapse Analytics**
---------------------------

Synapse Analytics builds AI-powered platforms that help financial institutions make faster, better, more transparent decisions. Konan, our decisioning and workflow platform, digitizes credit decisioning end to end inside banks and lenders. Doxter, our document intelligence platform, turns unstructured client documents into structured, usable data. We implement both inside regulated financial institutions across MENA and LATAM, and our Delivery team is the function that turns a signed contract into a live, value-generating platform.

**About the Role**
------------------

Konan and Doxter are only as valuable as how well they are configured to each client's reality. A bank's credit policy (its eligibility rules, scorecards, limits, and approval workflows) and a lender's document set have to be understood, translated, and built into the platform accurately. The Junior Technical Project Manager exists to become the product expert our clients and our delivery team rely on.

You will join our global Project Management team, work under a Senior Project Manager, and learn alongside our Konan subject matter experts. On assigned implementations you will own the product side of delivery: reviewing client credit and risk policies, ingesting them into Konan, configuring Doxter document extraction, proving through testing that every configuration behaves as the client intended, and helping clients get the most out of the platform once it is live. The role combines project management discipline with deep, hands-on product fluency.

This is a growth role. Within 12 to 18 months, we expect the right person to own the full product configuration of an implementation and to be recognised as the Konan and Doxter expert for a portfolio of clients.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

### **Konan Policy Review & Ingestion**

* Review client credit and risk policy documents, underwriting guidelines, and product programs, and break them down into structured, implementable logic: eligibility and knockout rules, scorecards, decision trees, limits, and pricing.
* Ingest and configure that policy logic in Konan under the guidance of our Konan subject matter experts, keeping a clear, version-controlled configuration record for every client.
* Spot gaps, ambiguities, and contradictions in client policies early, and work them through with the client's credit and risk teams before they reach the build.
* Map client requests to Konan's existing programs and capabilities (loan origination, onboarding, decisioning workflows) before anything is treated as custom work.

### **Doxter Document Intelligence Configuration**

* Analyse client document sets such as IDs, bank statements, salary certificates, financial statements, and contracts, and define the fields, rules, and validations each use case requires.
* Configure and tune Doxter extraction and validation, and track accuracy against the acceptance criteria agreed with the client.
* Work with Product and Data teams when new document types or accuracy gaps call for model improvements.

### **Configuration Testing & Validation**

* Build test cases and test data that prove each configured policy and document flow produces exactly the outcome the client expects.
* Run and support SIT and UAT for configurations, log defects clearly, and track them to resolution with engineering.
* Own configuration change requests after sign-off: assess the impact, update the configuration, retest, and document the change.

### **Client Enablement & Product Expertise**

* Be the product voice for your assigned clients: run demos and configuration workshops, and answer how-to and "can Konan do this" questions with confidence.
* Train client users and administrators on Konan and Doxter, and prepare user guides and enablement material.
* Support our Konan subject matter experts in producing data and decisioning insights from Konan outputs (approval rates, rule hit rates, policy performance) that help clients refine their policies.
* Hand over to Customer Success at go-live with complete, accurate configuration documentation.

### **Delivery Coordination**

* Plan and track the configuration workstream in ClickUp, owning your tasks, RAID items, and status inputs to the project plan.
* Translate between client business and risk teams and Synapse engineering, data, and product teams.
* Capture product feedback and feature gaps from clients as structured input for Product.
* Contribute reusable policy templates, configuration patterns, and lessons learned to the team's knowledge base.

We are looking for someone analytical and technically minded who loves getting deep into how a product really works, and who wants to become the person clients ask for by name. We are not looking for a finished product; we are looking for the foundations and the drive to build on them.

### **Background & Experience**

* 0 to 2 years of professional experience in software implementation, product configuration, business analysis, credit or risk analysis, QA, solutions consulting, or a similar role. Strong internships and graduate programmes count.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Any exposure to banking, lending, credit, or risk is a meaningful advantage.

### **Analytical & Technical Ability**

* Able to read a dense policy or rules document and extract its underlying logic accurately and completely.
* Comfortable with rule-based and logical structures: conditions, decision trees, calculations, and workflows.
* Comfortable working with data: advanced Excel, basic SQL, and structured formats such as JSON.
* Picks up software products quickly and is not satisfied until they understand how they really work.

### **Precision & Ownership**

* Attention to detail that borders on obsessive. A misconfigured rule means a wrong credit decision for a real customer.
* Highly organised; manages several client configurations at once and follows through without constant supervision.
* Takes initiative: sees what needs doing and does it.

### **Communication**

* Full professional fluency in both English and Arabic (written and spoken). This is mandatory.
* Able to explain policy and configuration logic clearly to credit, business, and technical audiences.
* Comfortable growing into leading demos, workshops, and training sessions.

### **Critical Thinking**

* Breaks complex policies and requirements into clear, testable components.
* Questions assumptions and asks what the client actually meant, not just what they wrote.
* Thinks about edge cases before they reach production.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with decision engines, rules engines, loan origination systems, workflow tools, or low-code platforms.
* Understanding of credit scoring, scorecards, or credit bureau data.
* Exposure to OCR or document AI products.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, or Postman.
* Experience with ClickUp, Jira, or a similar tool.

**What We Value**
-----------------

We are building the foundation of a global delivery team, and we hire for character as much as capability. Everyone on the team is expected to bring:

* **Respect** for clients, colleagues, and the teams we work alongside.
* **Responsibility** for your work and its outcome.
* **Reliability and accountability**: you do what you say, when you say, and you own it when something slips.
* **Honesty and trustworthiness**, especially when the news is not good.
* **Inner drive**: we provide the tools, systems, and opportunity; you bring the motivation to grow.

**Growth Path**
---------------

Junior Technical Project Manager, then Technical Project Manager (Konan and Doxter subject matter expert), with a path to Senior Project Manager or a senior product specialist track. Progression is based on demonstrated ownership and delivery outcomes, not time in seat.

title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Server OS Administrator
details:

This role is responsible for OS provisioning, hardening, patching, performance tuning, automation, and compliance ensuring enterprise compute workloads operate with maximum availability, security, and operational efficiency on OCI.

**Key Responsibilities**

**OCI Compute & Instance Management**

* Provision and manage OCI compute instances (VM, Bare Metal, Flex shapes) across Oracle Linux, RHEL, and Windows Server platforms.
* Configure and manage OCI instance metadata, cloud-init scripts, and custom images for standardized OS deployments.
* Build and maintain golden images (custom images, image pipelines) for Oracle Linux, RHEL, and Windows Server on OCI.
* Manage instance pools, autoscaling configurations, and capacity reservations for dynamic workload demands.
* Configure OCI boot/block volumes, volume groups, backup policies, and cross-region replication for OS-level storage.
* Manage OCI Bastion service and OS Management Hub for secure access and fleet management.

**Oracle Linux & RHEL Administration**

* Install, configure, and manage Oracle Linux (8.x/9.x) and RHEL (8.x/9.x) across OCI and on-premises environments.
* Administer kernel parameters, sysctl tuning, Huge Pages, NUMA, and kernel-level performance optimization.
* Manage package management using DNF/YUM, ULN (Unbreakable Linux Network), and Oracle Linux Manager/Spacewalk.
* Configure and maintain LVM, filesystems (ext4, XFS, OCFS2), multipath, and iSCSI storage at the OS layer.
* Administer systemd services, cron scheduling, and process management.
* Manage Oracle Ksplice for zero-downtime kernel patching on Oracle Linux.
* Configure SELinux policies, firewalld rules, and iptables/nftables for OS-level security.

**Windows Server Administration**

* Install, configure, and manage Windows Server (2019/2022/2025) on OCI compute instances.
* Administer Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), Group Policy Objects (GPOs), DNS, and DHCP in OCI-hosted or hybrid-connected Windows environments.
* Manage Windows Server roles and features: IIS, File Server, Print Server, WSUS, and Failover Clustering.
* Configure and manage Windows Remote Desktop Services (RDS) and Windows Admin Center.
* Administer Windows storage: Storage Spaces, ReFS, NTFS permissions, and iSCSI initiators.
* Manage Windows Update for Business, WSUS, and patch compliance across OCI-hosted Windows fleets.
* Configure Windows Defender, Windows Firewall with Advanced Security, and security baselines.

**OS Patching & Lifecycle Management**

* Design and execute OS patching strategies across Oracle Linux, RHEL, and Windows Server using OCI OS Management Hub.
* Manage patching schedules, patch compliance reporting, and exception handling across development, staging, and production environments.
* Implement zero-downtime patching workflows using Oracle Ksplice (Linux) and live patching techniques.
* Maintain OS lifecycle compliance track end-of-life, extended support, and upgrade paths across all supported OS versions.
* Coordinate patching windows with application and database teams, ensuring rollback readiness and change management alignment.

**Security Hardening & Compliance**

* Apply CIS benchmarks for Oracle Linux, RHEL, and Windows Server across all managed instances.
* Implement OS-level encryption: LUKS (Linux), BitLocker (Windows), and OCI Vault integration for key management.
* Configure and manage SSH hardening, PAM modules, sudoers policies, and certificate-based authentication (Linux).
* Manage local and domain-based access controls, privilege escalation policies, and service account governance.
* Implement audit logging using auditd (Linux), Windows Event Forwarding (WEF), and OCI Logging integration.
* Support compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, CIS) through evidence collection and remediation at the OS layer.

**Networking & OS-Level Connectivity**

* Configure OCI VNIC attachments, secondary VNICs, and OS-level network interface bonding/teaming.
* Manage OS-level DNS resolution, NTP/Chrony configuration, and host-based routing on OCI instances.
* Configure OS-level firewall rules aligned with OCI Security Lists and NSGs.
* Troubleshoot OS-level network issues including MTU, TCP tuning, and latency across OCI VCN topologies.
* Configure and manage VPN client connectivity and proxy settings for hybrid environments.

**Performance Monitoring & Tuning**

* Monitor OS performance metrics (CPU, memory, I/O, network) using OCI Monitoring Agent, OS Management Hub, and native OS tools (sar, vmstat, iostat, perfmon).
* Tune OS-level parameters for database, middleware, and application workloads including shared memory, semaphores, file descriptors, and kernel limits.
* Implement and manage OCI Compute metrics, custom alarms, and notifications for OS-level health monitoring.
* Conduct capacity planning and resource utilization analysis to inform scaling and right-sizing decisions.
* Integrate with enterprise monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, SCOM) for unified observability.

**Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

* Develop and maintain OS automation using Ansible, Terraform (OCI provider), and OCI Resource Manager.
* Build automated OS provisioning pipelines golden image creation, cloud-init bootstrapping, and post-provisioning configuration.
* Automate routine OS tasks: user management, log rotation, disk cleanup, certificate renewals, and compliance checks using Bash, Python, and PowerShell.
* Implement configuration management and drift detection using Ansible, Puppet, or Chef across managed fleets.
* Build self-service OS provisioning workflows integrated with CI/CD pipelines and ServiceNow ITSM.

**General**

* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles for OS administration procedures.
* Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, root cause analysis, and problem management.
* Collaborate with cloud architects, DBA teams, middleware teams, and client stakeholders on platform decisions.
* Mentor junior OS administrators and contribute to knowledge sharing within the practice.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8–10 years of progressive experience in server OS administration with hands-on expertise across Oracle Linux, RHEL, and Windows Server.
* Strong experience managing OS workloads on OCI (Compute instances, custom images, OS Management Hub).
* Expert-level knowledge of Linux administration: kernel tuning, LVM, filesystems, package management, systemd, SELinux, and firewalld.
* Expert-level knowledge of Windows Server administration: Active Directory, GPO, IIS, Failover Clustering, and Windows security baselines.
* Proven experience designing and executing enterprise OS patching strategies across mixed Linux/Windows fleets.
* Strong proficiency in OS automation using Ansible and at least one scripting language: Bash, Python, or PowerShell.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform with OCI provider) for compute provisioning.
* Solid understanding of OCI networking: VCNs, subnets, NSGs, VNICs, and service gateways as they relate to OS-level configuration.
* Experience applying CIS benchmarks and security hardening across Linux and Windows platforms.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to produce clear operational documentation and engage with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Oracle certifications: Oracle Linux System Administrator (OCA/OCP), OCI Architect Associate, OCI Operations Associate.
* Red Hat certifications: RHCSA, RHCE.
* Microsoft certifications: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ-800/AZ-801).
* Experience with Oracle Ksplice for zero-downtime kernel patching.
* Familiarity with OCI OS Management Hub and Oracle Linux Manager at scale.
* Experience with configuration management tools: Puppet, Chef, or SaltStack.
* Knowledge of container runtimes (Podman, Docker) and container host OS management on OCI.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, SCOM, or OEM.
* Familiarity with ITSM integration (ServiceNow) for automated provisioning and change management.
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management awareness.
* Experience working in managed services or consulting delivery environments.

title: Telecom Manager
details:
Req ID:513026

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time Telecom Manager in Cairo we’re looking for?

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your telecom engineering expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside experienced, collaborative, and forward-thinking teammates.

You'll play a critical role in ensuring the successful installation, testing, and commissioning of advanced telecom systems for railway networks. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (including civil works teams, project management, and engineering), oversee the execution of telecom activities on-site, and ensure compliance with safety and quality standards, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of supervising and inspecting telecom systems such as TCP/IP, IP-MPLS, CCTV, TETRA Radio Systems, and Public Address systems, but also contribute to creating innovative telecom architectures and solutions for projects.

**We’ll look to you for:**

* Coordinating activities of subcontractors on project planning, especially with civil works, and reporting to the regional Telecom Engineering head and Project Management.
* Supervising and inspecting all site telecommunications activities to ensure execution aligns with the Project Schedule, Site Specific Work Plans, and Approved Work Methods.
* Performing field inspections to ensure compliance with safety policies, procedures, and approved work methods.
* Supporting the commissioning team during the testing phase and ensuring seamless handovers with appropriate documentation.
* Analyzing requirements and proposing cost-effective solutions to the track lead engineer.
* Ensuring the design adheres to health and safety standards.
* Coordinating with other entities (e.g., other Alstom activities, civil work partners) on technical interfaces, especially with civil works.
* Resolving technical open issues on-site, from investigation to modification implementation and problem closure.
* Planning, executing, monitoring, and controlling design, configuration, maintenance, testing, and commissioning activities for telecommunication systems.
* Maintaining and coordinating As-Built Documentation submissions.
* Deploying and sizing networks, including fiber optic transmission and other physical deployments.
* Monitoring and maintaining network performance using tools like protocol analyzers and quality of service indicators.

**All about you**

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Communication Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of network infrastructure (e.g., switches, routers, firewalls, media converters).
* Understanding of associated protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, MPLS, LAN-WAN) and routing principles (static & dynamic).
* Familiarity with complex network design—both wired and wireless—and network architecture design.
* Experience in telecom subsystems and interfaces (railway systems experience is a plus).
* Working knowledge of switching and routing protocols.
* Experience with wireless communications in demanding scenarios.
* Prior experience managing medium-to-large projects and project teams.
* CCNA & CCNP certification (preferred).
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including with third parties (e.g., clients).
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
* Detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills.
* Experience in railway signalling systems is a plus.

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines.
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling.
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects.
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning.
* Progress towards leadership roles or specialized technical expertise.
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

details:

Working closely with the Network Operations Centre (NOC), Managed Services Engineering teams, Customer Success Managers, and other operational stakeholders, the Service Desk Engineer provides initial troubleshooting, incident classification, customer communication, and escalation management. The L1.5 level carries additional responsibilities for handling more complex technical issues, supporting first-line escalations, maintaining service quality, and providing operational guidance to L1 engineers.

Responsibilities:

Incident & Service Request Management (L1 and L1.5)

* Respond to customer portal requests and hotline calls within agreed response targets, ensuring accurate issue identification and documentation.
* Log all customer requests and incidents in ServiceNow, including requests received through email, Account Managers, or Customer Success Managers, within one business day.
* Classify tickets as incidents, service requests, or changes, and assign priorities in accordance with agreed priority matrices and customer contracts.
* Provide first-contact resolution for standard technical issues, including password resets, MFA, account unlocks, Microsoft 365 access, VPN connectivity, printer issues, basic client troubleshooting, and standard access requests.
* Route tickets to the appropriate technical teams, including Cloud & Compute, Network & Connectivity, Database & Middleware, Backup & DR, and End-User Computing, ensuring complete documentation of symptoms, troubleshooting steps, screenshots, and business impact.
* Maintain regular customer communication, providing updates at agreed intervals and confirming issue resolution before ticket closure.
* Immediately escalate P1/P2 incidents through the major incident management process and provide initial customer communication.
* Follow established escalation procedures for customer dissatisfaction or potential SLA breaches.
* Ensure all privileged access is managed through PAM360 and comply with customer access and data-handling policies.

Advanced Technical Support & Escalation Management (L1.5)

* Handle first-line escalations from L1 engineers and troubleshoot more complex technical issues, including Entra ID / Active Directory group and policy issues, Intune enrolment and compliance basics, Windows client troubleshooting, and basic network connectivity checks.
* Perform N-able N-central tasks, including agent health monitoring, patch status checks, remote support sessions using Take Control, and scheduled maintenance checks.
* Support the NOC in managing Site24x7 and N-able alerts that develop into customer incidents.
* Review the quality of L1 tickets regularly, ensuring accurate classification, prioritization, documentation, and closure codes, while providing coaching and guidance to L1 engineers.

* Microsoft 365 administration, including Entra ID user administration, Exchange Online basics, Teams, and OneDrive.

title: Maintenance Assistant Manager
details:

title: Infrastructure Security Engineer, EGYPT
details:
**Infrastructure Security Engineer, EGYPT**
-------------------------------------------

**A**bout nsave

nsave is a fintech company headquartered in London. Founded by Amer Baroudi and Abdallah AbuHashem, our vision is to "Protect and grow the wealth of the financially excluded". We have built a global platform that provides trusted USD accounts, global payments, and investments for individuals from distressed economies, where inflation is high and banking systems are unstable. Our compliance-by-design approach and proprietary technology allow us to deliver these services securely and at scale.

To date, nsave has raised $22M from leading investors including Sequoia Capital, TQ Ventures, Y Combinator, and SV Angel. Our team has grown 200% in the last year, and with so much more ahead, we're just getting started!

Learn more at www.nsave.com.

Location: Egypt (Remote)

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor

**About the Role**
------------------

As our Infrastructure Security Engineer, you will own security at nsave end-to-end — from cloud infrastructure hardening to driving us through formal compliance certifications. Working closely with the CTO, you will be the person who ensures that the trust our customers place in us is backed by world-class security practice. This is a foundational role: you'll set the bar for how we build, operate, and certify a regulated fintech platform at scale.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* Security engineer, not just an auditor: You can write policy and pass an audit, but you're equally comfortable getting hands-on in the infrastructure, identifying gaps, and fixing them.
* Fintech or regulated-industry background: You have worked in fintech, banking, or payments — ideally in a regulated environment — and understand the unique risk, data privacy, and compliance obligations that come with it.
* Clear communicator: You can translate technical risk into plain language for non-technical stakeholders, leadership, and external auditors.
* Proactive and ownership-driven: You don't wait to be told where the risks are — you go looking for them.

**Must Have**
-------------

* AWS Organizations design: Hands-on experience designing and building an AWS Organization from the ground up — multi-account structure, Organisational Units, Service Control Policies, and least-privilege IAM across every account.
* Cloud network security: Deep experience securing cloud networks — VPC design and segmentation, security groups and NACLs, private connectivity, and WAF / DDoS protection.
* Infrastructure as code: Strong hands-on Terraform experience — you define infrastructure and security controls as code, and build guardrails into CI/CD so the secure path is the default one.
* Endpoint security: Experience securing endpoints across a remote team — EDR, device management (MDM), hardening baselines, patching, and disk encryption.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Security operations (SOC): Experience setting up or working in a Security Operations Centre — SIEM, log monitoring, alerting, threat detection, and incident response.
* Compliance certifications: Experience taking a company through PCI DSS, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 — designing controls, gathering evidence, and working with auditors.

**How You'll Make a Difference**
--------------------------------

* Own our security posture: Define, implement, and continuously improve nsave's information security programme across infrastructure, application, and operational layers.
* Lead compliance certifications: Drive nsave through relevant security certifications (PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001), owning the end-to-end process from gap analysis through to audit and accreditation.
* Harden our cloud environment: Design and secure our AWS Organization and account structure — enforcing least-privilege access, securing our cloud network, and managing it all as code in Terraform.
* Secure our endpoints: Own endpoint security across our remote team — device management, EDR, and hardening standards for every laptop that touches production.
* Embed security into engineering: Partner with backend and platform engineers to build security into our SDLC — code reviews, threat modelling, secrets management, dependency scanning, and CI/CD pipeline security.
* Manage risk and incidents: Maintain our risk register, lead incident response when needed, and conduct post-mortems that drive lasting improvements.
* Vendor and third-party security: Assess the security posture of third-party tools and partners, ensuring our supply chain meets the standards expected of a regulated financial platform.
* Build a security-first culture: Run internal training, champion secure-by-default practices, and make security something the whole team owns.

**nsave Values**
----------------

* Service — "Mission First": We put the mission, our customers, and our team above self.
* Urgency — "Stay focused. Move fast": We act with urgency and intention, concentrating on what matters most.
* Ownership — "Act as an Owner": We take responsibility for outcomes end-to-end.
* Standards — "Pursue Excellence": We hold ourselves to high personal standards and continuously improve.

**Please apply only if you:**
-----------------------------

* Are deeply motivated by nsave's mission and the problems we are solving
* Thrive in high-ownership, high-accountability environments
* Are comfortable operating with urgency and ambiguity
* Want to build from first principles in an early-stage, high-growth company

*This role is offered on a freelance / independent contractor basis. Contractors are not employees of nsave and are responsible for their own taxes, insurance, and statutory obligations.*

*nsave is an equal opportunity organisation. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.*

title: IT Help Desk Engineer
details:
**Role Purpose:**

The IT Service Support Analyst delivers high-quality first-line technical assistance, end-user computing support, and incident management across DHL Express. Operating within established IT Service Management frameworks, this role ensures timely resolution of hardware, software, and connectivity issues while maintaining operational integrity, IT compliance, and service level commitments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Deliver professional, customer-focused first-line technical support to internal users across phone, email, and the designated enterprise ITSM portal.
* Manage incidents, service requests, and technical problems throughout their entire lifecycle in alignment with ITIL service management standards.
* Ensure all technical issues and user requests are accurately logged, categorized, prioritized, tracked, and resolved within established Service Level Agreements and Operational Level Agreements.

**Purpose of the job**

You will be part of a team of several Quality of Service and Radio Optimization engineers, were you will be responsible for carrying out RAN engineering studies (quality monitoring and optimization) for subsidiaries involved in the REC and ensuring the consistency of the configuration and activation of 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G (and soon 6G) radio features over time.

You will also provide support to subsidiaries involved in the REC to ensure the technological evolution of existing radio sites through the management of technology trials and the implementation of Group recommendations to meet our customers' expectations in terms of improving Radio Quality of Service.

In terms of ongoing activity for our customers, you will participate in the analysis of drive tests and the operation of automatic optimization tools (C-SON) to continuously improve Radio performance.

**Duties and responsibilities**

As a design and planning engineer for radio, the main activities will include:

* Conducting budget studies (estimation of the need for new sites) each year, as well as updates for budget reviews
* Monitoring the deployment of sites included in the budget program, with subsidiaries
* Regularly managing with subsidiaries, the evolution of radio site configurations (e.g. new sites, antenna optimization, etc.), to ensure that the subsidiaries' mobile network site databases are kept up to date in our radio planning tools (e.g. Asset / Atoll)
* Carrying out optimization actions for mobile network planning: frequency plans in 2G, scrambling codes in 3G, PCI in 4G, etc.
* Recommending optimization actions for radio design and planning to reduce coverage and capacity constraints in areas or layers with several technologies (traffic steering, etc.)
* Carrying out cross-disciplinary or specific technical studies for radio engineering (e.g., indoor coverage, stadiums, etc.)

**Job specification**

**Engineers with 1 to 10+ years of experience**  
**French speakers**

With a background in mobile telecommunications engineering, you have at least 2 years of experience and you have the Following Skills:

**Business skills**

* Ability to listen and understand customer needs
* Ability to convince, manage and motivate people
* Ability to work in functional relationships with experts from other organizations and countries

**Technical Skills**

* Knowledge of radio planning tools used in the Orange group
* RPT (radio planning tool): Asset, Atoll
* ACP (automated cell planning) and AFP (automated frequency planning) tools
* Knowledge of antenna equipment, hardware & site engineering
* Knowledge of the engineering and operational issues of 2G/3G/4G/5G mobile access networks and their operation
* Skills in radio engineering and optimization, other than design: optimization, troubleshooting, tools, would be an asset
* Knowledge in the field of network automation (C-SON) would also be an asset
* Knowledge of propagation model tuning
* Experience in office applications: various RF tools such as MapInfo or **QGIS**, post-processing software, etc.,
* Very good knowledge of radio tools for drive test analysis (Nemo, Tems, Actix)
* Very good knowledge of the architecture and interfaces of mobile networks would be an asset
* Very good knowledge of the main radio procedures (Selection, reselection, handover, paging, CSFB, VoLTE, etc.) would be an asset
* Very good knowledge of 3GPP standards and L3 protocol messages would be an asset
* **Basic programming skills, such as experience with Visual Basic, to develop database queries that convert raw statistics into useful information would be an asset**
* The application of these skills is directly related to the tasks of the position described above and this on 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G networks.

title: Oracle Cloud Engineer
details:
**Job Description:**

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer with deep hands-on expertise in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) to design, build, migrate, and operate enterprise-grade cloud environments. This role spans the full OCI stack from core infrastructure and cloud-native services to DevOps automation and Oracle application workloads and is central to delivering scalable, secure, and resilient solutions for our clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

**OCI Infrastructure (Compute, Networking, Storage, IAM)**

* Design and implement OCI tenancy architectures including compartment structures, VCNs, subnets, security lists, NSGs, and DRGs.
* Provision and manage compute instances (VM, BM, Flex), block/object/file storage, and load balancers.
* Configure IAM policies, identity federation, dynamic groups, and instance principals following least-privilege principles.
* Implement network security architectures including FastConnect, IPSec VPN, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Cloud Guard.

**Cloud Migration**

* Lead end-to-end migration of workloads from on-premises and other cloud platforms to OCI.
* Perform discovery, assessment, and dependency mapping using Oracle Cloud Migrations, RackWare, or equivalent tooling.
* Execute migration strategies (Rehost, Re-platform, Refactor) aligned with business and technical requirements.
* Plan and implement database migrations using OCI Database Migration Service, Data Pump, GoldenGate, or ZDM (Zero Downtime Migration).

**Cloud-Native & DevOps on OCI**

* Build and manage containerized workloads on OCI Container Engine for Kubernetes (OKE).
* Design CI/CD pipelines using OCI DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or ArgoCD.
* Author and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform (OCI Resource Manager), Ansible, or Pulumi.
* Implement observability stacks leveraging OCI Monitoring, Logging, Logging Analytics, and APM.

**OCI for Oracle Application Workloads**

* Deploy and manage Oracle Database services on OCI (DB Systems, Exadata Cloud Service, Autonomous Database).
* Architect OCI environments to host Oracle E-Business Suite, PeopleSoft, JD Edwards, and Fusion Middleware.
* Configure Oracle Data Guard, RMAN, and Autonomous Data Guard for high availability and disaster recovery.
* Optimize performance for Oracle workloads using OCI-native tools (Database Management, Operations Insights, Performance Hub).

**General**

* Develop and maintain architecture documentation including HLDs, runbooks, and operational playbooks.
* Collaborate with solution architects, application teams, and client stakeholders to translate requirements into OCI designs.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior cloud engineers.
* Participate in incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 7 - 8 years of progressive experience in cloud engineering with a minimum of 4 years focused on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
* Strong hands-on expertise with OCI core services: Compute, Networking, Storage, IAM, Database, and Security.
* Proven experience delivering cloud migration projects (on-prem to OCI or cross-cloud).
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform with OCI provider is mandatory).
* Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes / OKE) and CI/CD pipeline design.
* Solid understanding of Oracle Database technologies (RAC, Data Guard, ASM, RMAN, GoldenGate).
* Working knowledge of Linux administration and shell scripting.
* Experience with at least one scripting/automation language: Python, Bash, or Go.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts (DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPN, peering).
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and present to client stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**

* OCI certifications: OCI Architect Associate, OCI Architect Professional, OCI DevOps Professional, OCI Database Professional.
* Additional cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, or GCP equivalent).
* Experience with Oracle E-Business Suite, PeopleSoft, or Fusion Middleware deployments on OCI.
* Familiarity with FinOps practices and OCI Cost Analysis / Budgets.
* Experience with GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Flux) and policy-as-code frameworks (OPA, Sentinel).
* Knowledge of Oracle Autonomous Database and its operational model.
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management awareness.
* Experience working in managed services or consulting delivery environments.

details:

30 November 2026-23:59-GMT+02:00 Eastern European Standard Time (Cairo)

**ABOUT WFP**  
  
The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of extreme weather shocks.

At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.  
  
To learn more about WFP, visit our website: https://www.wfp.org

**WHY JOIN WFP?**

* WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.
* WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.
* WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.
* A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.
* We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the **Terms and Conditions** section of this vacancy announcement).

**ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT**
==========================

The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) is the world's largest humanitarian agency, fighting hunger worldwide. The WFP Technology Division (TEC) is the digital business engine of the World Food Programme, providing the business with multi-pronged and resilient technical capabilities able to respond with the agility required in humanitarian operations, be they manmade or in a natural disaster setting.

TEC’s Digital Solutions Branch (TECD) oversees all solution development activities for WFP, covering the full technology stack and delivering changes to existing solutions. This function manages all aspects of development, from understanding business requirements to designing and building solutions, and overseeing quality assurance. TECD is expanding their service offering into the support and adoption of corporate tools used on the front line of WFP’s operations.

TECD’s Global Beneficiary Services (GBS) team supports the adoption and effective use of corporate IT solutions that enable Programme delivery across WFP operations. GBS provides guidance, training, and Tier 2 support to Country Offices (CO) adopting these tools. Members of the team are spread across WFP’s five Regional Offices (RO) to provide follow-the-sun support in the time zone and language of our COs.

**BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT**
============================================

Under the direct supervision of the Head of GBS, the IT Associate - Product Adoption and Support will provide independent operational and technical support for the adoption, rollout and sustained use of corporate IT solutions across Country Offices in the region. Compared with an assistant-level role, the SC-6 function carries greater responsibility for Tier 2 troubleshooting, requirements analysis, implementation support, user enablement, service performance monitoring, knowledge management and coordination with Regional Office and HQ product teams.

The incumbent will analyse incidents and recurring service issues, recommend corrective actions, support deployments and adoption activities, coach local support teams, and contribute to measurable improvement in service quality and user experience. The role requires sound judgement, customer focus, structured problem solving and the ability to manage several priorities with limited supervision.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES / DUTIES**
=================================

**1. Product support and service management**
---------------------------------------------

* Provide Tier 2 functional and technical support for assigned corporate products, resolving incidents and service requests within agreed service targets and escalating complex defects to product or engineering teams with complete diagnostic evidence.
* Perform structured troubleshooting using error information, logs, configuration checks, user scenarios and available knowledge articles; identify root causes or contributing factors for recurring issues and recommend sustainable corrective actions.
* Monitor assigned support queues, priorities, ageing tickets and SLA performance; follow up on escalations and keep users and stakeholders informed through resolution.
* Identify recurring incidents and service improvement opportunities; contribute to problem records, knowledge articles, standard operating procedures and reusable troubleshooting guidance.
* Support access, configuration, data-quality and integration-related investigations within the incumbent's authorised scope, applying established information-security and data-protection requirements.

**2. Product adoption and country-office readiness**
----------------------------------------------------

* Advise Country Offices on the appropriate use of corporate digital solutions supporting programme delivery, including SCOPE, SugarCRM, NEST, CIAM, School Connect, Partner Connect, CODA and PIT, in line with approved product guidance.
* Engage Country Offices to understand operational requirements, business processes, readiness gaps, user groups and support needs; consolidate findings and provide structured inputs to product and GBS teams.
* Develop or adapt adoption materials, user guidance, checklists and support resources to improve readiness and consistent use of digital products.
* Track adoption issues, user feedback and implementation risks, and coordinate follow-up actions with relevant Country Office, Regional Office and HQ stakeholders.

**3. Rollout and implementation support**
-----------------------------------------

* Provide technical and operational support to pilots, deployments and scale-up activities, including readiness checks, issue tracking, validation of agreed configurations and post-deployment follow-up.
* Coordinate testing and user feedback for assigned implementations and ensure issues are documented with clear reproduction steps, business impact and recommended next actions.
* Conduct training, demonstrations and awareness sessions for end users and local support teams; develop practical learning materials and assess common knowledge gaps.
* Undertake local and international missions as required to support adoption, troubleshooting, rollout and capacity-building activities.

**4. Collaboration, analysis and knowledge management**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Act as a dependable coordination point between Country Offices, Regional Office colleagues, GBS and HQ product teams for assigned products and support topics.
* Produce concise service updates and operational analysis using ticket data, user feedback and adoption information to highlight trends, risks, bottlenecks and improvement actions.
* Maintain accurate and reusable documentation of solutions, procedures, lessons learned, FAQs and known errors, and promote consistent use of the team knowledge base.
* Share implementation experience and user insights with the wider team to strengthen standards, product usability and continuous improvement.
* Perform other related duties as required within the scope of the function.

**EXPECTED RESULTS / DELIVERABLES**
===================================

* Timely and accurate handling of assigned incidents and service requests, with at least 90% handled within applicable first-point-of-contact or response timelines where those targets apply.
* Contribution to at least 90% SLA adherence for the support services within the role's area of responsibility, subject to agreed service definitions and dependencies.
* Structured analysis and follow-up of recurring incidents, including documented root-cause findings or escalation evidence and recommended corrective actions.
* Country Offices supported with documented readiness, rollout, training and adoption activities for assigned products.
* Up-to-date knowledge articles, SOP contributions, FAQs, troubleshooting guides and lessons learned maintained for assigned support areas.
* Regular, concise reporting on service trends, adoption issues, risks and follow-up actions for management and product teams.
* Demonstrated transfer of knowledge to local support teams and end users, reducing avoidable repeat requests and strengthening local support capability.

**DESIRED TECHNICAL / FUNCTIONAL CAPABILITIES**
===============================================

* Experience supporting digital platforms used in programme or operational delivery environments.
* Working knowledge of ITIL-aligned service-management practices, including incident, request, problem, knowledge and service-level management.
* Ability to use service and operational data to identify trends, monitor KPIs and communicate actionable insights.
* Practical experience facilitating user training, product demonstrations and adoption/change activities across multicultural teams.
* Ability to document functional issues clearly for technical teams and translate technical guidance into user-friendly instructions.

WFP Leadership Framework guides to the common standards of behavior that guide HOW we work together to accomplish our mission.

The United Nations does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process. Should you receive a solicitation for the payment of a fee, please disregard it. Furthermore, please note that emblems, logos, names and addresses are easily copied and reproduced. * We strongly recommend that your Workday profile is accurate and complete, and that all sections are filled in, including your employment history, academic qualifications, language skills, and UN grade (if applicable). Once your profile is completed, please apply, and submit your application.
* If you experience technical issues while submitting your application, you may contact us at global.hrerecruitment@wfp.org. Please note that this email is **only** for technical issues with an application - **unsolicited applications or documents sent to this inbox will not receive a reply**.
* At the application stage, the only required documents are your CV and Cover Letter. Additional documents (passport, certificates, recommendation letters, etc.) may be requested later in the process.

**Terre des hommes (Tdh) :**  
  
The Terre des hommes Foundation (Tdh), with headquarters in Lausanne and an office in Zurich, is the leading Swiss child rights organisation with more than 2000 employees worldwide. We stand together with children to uphold their rights, protect their lives and improve their well-being. We achieve this through innovative programmes focused on health, migration and access to justice, specifically designed to have a positive and sustainable impact.

Terre des hommes Lausanne (Tdh), the largest Swiss child rights organisation, is reshaping its operating model to be closer to children and young people in situations of vulnerability across the thirty or so countries where it works.

In the Middle East and North Africa, Tdh works [to be completed: countries of direct implementation and partnership countries, including Egypt, Jordan, Palestine and Iraq.

Under the line management of the Egypt Logistic manager and the functional supervision of the Regional ICT/ICT4D Manager, the ICT Officer serves as the local technical point of contact. The postholder provides first-level technical support, maintains IT infrastructure and oversees the day-to-day operation of equipment and networks across several countries.

The ICT Officer ensures the availability of IT tools and contributes to the quality of IT services delivered to country teams.

The ICT Officer plays a key role in:

* providing user support (Level 1 service desk);
* managing IT infrastructure;
* performing basic network administration;
* providing operational support to delegations.

**Specific responsibilities:**

* Provide day-to-day on-site and remote user support (Level 1 helpdesk).
* Diagnose and resolve common technical incidents (workstations, printers, connectivity, Microsoft 365).
* Install, configure and maintain end-user computers and devices, network equipment (routers, switches, Wi-Fi) and connectivity solutions (Internet, VPN).

* Apply and promote regional IT standards.
* Support the roll-out of IT solutions (deployments, collaboration tools, etc.).

title: Technical Support Engineer
details:
Job Purpose The Technical Support Engineer is responsible for ensuring that systems and users of its SaaS products receive timely, accurate, and high‑quality technical support. The role is designed to resolve customer issues, maintain high customer satisfaction, provide product expertise, and coordinate internally to improve product stability, usability, and performance. This position is an essential element between users, the product development team, and customer success, helping deliver solutions, minimize downtime, and drive continuous improvement.  
  
Job Responsibilities:

Ticket & Issue Management

* Receive, log, and prioritize support tickets from clients using our system products.
* Diagnose technical issues, perform root cause analysis, identify workarounds, and escalate complex issues when necessary.
* Follow up on open tickets, ensure SLAs are met, and maintain transparency with clients on resolution status.

Customer Communication & Support

* Interact with clients via email, phone, chat, or customer support portals to gather necessary information, explain solutions, and provide updates.
* Ensure communication is clear, professional, and empathetic, especially under pressure or when dealing with upset or frustrated users.

Product Expertise & Documentation

* Acquire deep understanding of the architecture, features, configuration, integrations, and quirks.
* Maintain and update internal knowledge base / FAQs / support documentation to both assist the support team and empower users.
* Create user‑oriented guides, troubleshooting checklists, and best practice recommendations.

Monitoring, Maintenance, & Preventative Action

* Monitor system alerts, logs, performance metrics, or error trends to proactively identify potential issues before they escalate.
* Collaborate with DevOps / Product / Engineering teams to facilitate fixes of bugs, performance issues, or system improvements.
* Suggest improvements to enhance product stability, usability, or performance based on recurring issues and client feedback.

Onboarding & Training

* Assist with technical onboarding of new clients/users: configuring the product, setting up integrations, performing initial troubleshooting, and ensuring smooth adoption.
* Provide training sessions / demos to clients as needed, including remote training or workshops.

Collaboration & Feedback Loop

* Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, QA to report bugs, issue trends, and feature requests from clients.
* Participate in frequent reviews of support metrics (e.g., ticket volume, resolution time, customer satisfaction) and help strategize improvements.
* Collaborate with other internal teams (sales, account management, customer success) to ensure the client’s perspective is represented.

Quality & Performance Metrics

* Meet or exceed KPIs such as first response time, average resolution time, ticket backlog, client satisfaction (CSAT) / Net Promoter Score (NPS) if applicable.
* Ensure documentation quality, maintain high standards for response quality, and maintain compliance with company policies.

 **Requirements**  

* 2-5 years of experience in technical support, application support, or IT operations within a SaaS or technology company.
* Hands-on experience supporting enterprise software or SaaS platforms.
* Strong understanding of web-based applications, APIs, and integration troubleshooting.
* Proven experience handling support tickets, troubleshooting issues, working with cross‑functional teams

Technical Skills:

* Familiarity with ticketing and support systems (e.g., Jira, Zendesk, Freshdesk).
* Strong problem‑solving and debugging skills
* Solid understanding of databases (SQL), server logs, networking basics, and system monitoring tools.
* Experience in troubleshooting application issues, user access problems, and performance bottlenecks.
* Ability to read and interpret logs, API responses, and technical error messages.
