title: B2B Marketing Lead
details:
**About Integrant**

For more than 34 years, Integrant has designed and delivered advanced business solutions for U.S. enterprises across biotech, medical devices, manufacturing, finance, and other highly regulated industries. Our teams bring deep expertise in web and mobile applications, data engineering, AI, machine learning, high-performance computing, and Agentic solutions. We build long-term partnerships by solving mission-critical business problems with rigor, empathy, and measurable outcomes.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for a high-caliber, hands-on B2B Marketing Lead to help position Integrant’s AI and Agentic capabilities—particularly our ADLC offering—in the U.S. enterprise market. This is an individual-contributor role for a strategic marketer who is equally comfortable shaping a go-to-market story, collaborating with technical SMEs, producing compelling content, and executing integrated campaigns. You will play a central role in building a credible market presence and generating qualified leads for Integrant’s AI and Agentic services. This is not a pure social media, SEO, or brand-management role. We need someone who understands how B2B technology-services buyers think and can turn complex technical expertise into compelling, business-focused messaging and campaigns.

**What You’ll Do**

**Strategy & Positioning**

* Own the marketing positioning and narrative for Integrant’s AI, Agentic, and ADLC capabilities.
* Develop a strong understanding of our ideal customer profile, buyer personas, enterprise pain points, and buying journey. Translate technical capabilities into clear, differentiated business value for U.S. enterprise prospects.
* Research market trends, competitor messaging, and buyer needs to continuously strengthen campaign positioning.
* Partner with sales and leadership to ensure marketing activities support qualified-lead and pipeline goals.

**Content & Thought Leadership**

* Build and manage a content strategy that establishes Integrant as a credible partner in AI and Agentic solutions.
* Produce or lead the creation of high-quality marketing assets, including thought-leadership articles, case studies, solution briefs, white papers, website content, sales collateral, LinkedIn content, email content, and webinar materials.
* Interview and collaborate closely with technical SMEs to extract insights and convert them into clear, engaging, market-ready content.
* Maintain a high bar for quality, accuracy, relevance, and consistency across all marketing communications.

**Integrated Campaign Execution**

* Plan and execute integrated B2B campaigns targeting U.S. enterprise prospects.
* Lead a year-end campaign around Integrant’s ADLC and Agentic offerings, from campaign concept and messaging through asset creation, launch, optimization, and reporting.
* Coordinate campaign activity across LinkedIn, email, paid media, webinars/events, website/landing pages, and outbound-sales enablement.
* Work with internal stakeholders and external specialists or agencies, where applicable, to ensure timely and high-quality execution.
* Create campaign briefs, timelines, and clear performance reporting.

**Demand Generation & Measurement**

* Focus marketing efforts on generating qualified leads—not only awareness or vanity metrics.
* Define and track relevant funnel metrics, including target-account engagement, content performance, marketing-qualified leads, sales-qualified leads, meetings, and pipeline influence.
* Continuously analyze results and improve messaging, content, audiences, and channels based on performance.
* Establish a practical feedback loop with sales to assess lead quality and refine targeting.

  
**Requirements**  

* 8+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience within software, technology, IT services, digital engineering, or technology consulting.
* Proven experience marketing B2B services or solutions—not only consumer products, e-commerce, or employer branding.
* Demonstrated ownership of integrated marketing campaigns that supported lead generation, qualified meetings, or pipeline growth.
* Strong content strategy and writing capabilities, with a portfolio of relevant B2B technology content.
* Experience translating complex technical topics into compelling business-focused messaging.
* Exposure to AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, data, cloud, software engineering, or digital transformation topics is strongly preferred.
* Experience working with technical SMEs, product teams, engineers, or solution architects.
* Understanding of U.S. or international B2B markets; experience targeting enterprise buyers is highly preferred.
* Practical experience with key channels such as LinkedIn, email marketing, paid media, webinars/events, landing pages, and sales enablement.
* Strong analytical mindset and ability to connect marketing activity to lead quality and pipeline outcomes.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, project-management, and presentation skills.
* High ownership, sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to execute independently in a fast-moving environment.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience marketing AI/Agentic solutions, enterprise software, or technology services to regulated industries.
* Experience with account-based marketing, demand generation, HubSpot or comparable automation platforms, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, CRM reporting, or intent-data tools.
* Experience supporting U.S.-based clients or distributed international teams.
* Experience working with external content, design, paid-media, or web-development partners.

  
**Benefits**  

* Salary paid in USD
* Six-month career advancing opportunities
* Supportive and friendly work environment
* Premium medical insurance [employee +family]
* English language development courses
* Interest-free loans paid over 2.5 years
* Technical development courses
* Employment referral program
* Premium location in Maadi
* Social insurance

title: Digital Design Engineer
details:
**Title: Digital Design Engineer**

  

**About GF**  
GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. **Responsibilities**

* Develop, document, and maintain RTL (SystemVerilog/Verilog) for digital subsystems within the CPO product, including control logic, register interfaces, link management, and DFT structures.
* Collaborate with architecture, analog/mixed-signal, and photonics teams to define digital interfaces and control schemes for co-packaged optical modules.
* Own micro-architecture specifications, design reviews, and integration of digital IP into the top-level SoC.
* Drive synthesis, timing closure, CDC, lint, and low-power (UPF) sign-off in coordination with the physical design team.
* Perform FPGA prototyping and testing of digital subsystems to validate functionality, accelerate pre-silicon software bring-up, and de-risk RTL ahead of tape-out.
* Develop and execute UVM-based testing, including building reusable verification components, writing constrained-random tests, and driving functional and code coverage closure.
* Support verification efforts by collaborating with the DV team on testbench development, coverage closure, and debug.
* Participate in tape-out readiness activities, including ECO planning, gate-level simulation, and post-silicon bring-up support.
* Contribute to design methodology, reuse strategy, and quality improvements across the team.
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 1+ years of experience in digital RTL design using SystemVerilog/Verilog.
* Solid understanding of digital design fundamentals: synchronous design, CDC, FSMs, pipelining, and low-power techniques.
* Hands-on experience with industry EDA tools (synthesis, lint, CDC, simulation).
* Familiarity with scripting (Python, TCL, Perl) for design automation.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a cross-functional team.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with high-speed serial interfaces (SerDes, PCIe, Ethernet, CXL) or optical link control.
* Exposure to silicon photonics, co-packaged optics, or advanced packaging products.
* Experience with ARM-based SoC integration, AMBA protocols (AXI/AHB/APB), and standard IP integration flows.
* Prior tape-out experience on advanced process nodes.

title: DevOps Engineer, POWER
details:
Valeo is a tech global company, designing breakthrough solutions to reinvent the mobility. We are an automotive supplier partner to automakers and new mobility actors worldwide. Our vision? Invent a greener and more secured mobility, thanks to solutions focusing on intuitive driving and reducing CO2 emissions. We are leader on our businesses, and recognized as one of the largest global innovative companies.

We are seeking a dedicated **CI/CD & DevOps Engineer** to join our automotive test automation team.

Our team focuses on providing automation features for Testing in ECU-TEST, as well as our Focus on the infrastructure, pipeline architecture, and deployment mechanisms that make those tests run efficiently.

  

You will contribute to the Jenkins ecosystem, managing the complex orchestration required to run automated software tests on physical Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test benches. This is a specialized DevOps role that bridges the gap between modern CI/CD practices and automotive hardware testing, ensuring our integration and delivery pipelines are scalable, fast, and highly reliable.

  

### **What You Will Do**

* **Pipeline Architecture & Development:** Design, build, and maintain advanced declarative and scripted Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to automate software builds, HIL testing, and deployment.

  

* **Jenkins Administration:** Manage Jenkins controllers and agents, specifically focusing on the allocation, health, and routing of jobs to specialized HIL test bench nodes.

  

* **Infrastructure & Containerization:** Utilize Docker to containerize build environments, test tools, and utility scripts to ensure consistent pipeline execution across different machines.

  

* **Toolchain Integration:** Integrate Jenkins with version control (Git/Bitbucket), test execution tools (TraceTronic ECU-TEST), artifact repositories, and analytics dashboards (TEST-GUIDE).

  

* **Scripting & Automation:** Write and maintain Jenkins Shared Libraries in Groovy, and develop backend automation scripts in Python or Bash/PowerShell to optimize pipeline performance.

  

* **Monitoring & Reliability:** Implement monitoring and alerting for CI/CD infrastructure to proactively resolve bottlenecks, pipeline failures, or offline HIL nodes.

  

* **Security & Compliance:** Ensure CI/CD pipelines adhere to internal security guidelines, managing credentials, access control, and secure artifact storage.

  

### **What We Are Looking For (Required Qualifications)**

* **Experience:** 1–2 years of dedicated experience in a DevOps, Release Engineering, or CI/CD focused role.

  

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related technical field.

  

* **CI/CD & Jenkins Skills:** Practical experience building and maintaining pipelines in Jenkins. You are able to write standard Jenkinsfiles, configuring jobs, and understanding the basics of managing Jenkins nodes and agents.

  

* **Programming & Scripting:** Strong coding skills in Groovy (for Jenkins pipelines and Shared Libraries) and Python or Bash/PowerShell for general automation.

  

* **DevOps Tooling:** Hands-on experience with Docker (containerization) and advanced version control workflows (Git branching strategies, code review enforcement).

  

* **System Administration:** Foundational knowledge of operating systems (Windows and Linux) and networking, as HIL test benches require specialized node configuration.

  

* **Analytical Problem Solving:** Excellent troubleshooting skills for debugging pipeline failures, environment inconsistencies, and network connectivity issues.

**Nice to Have (Bonus Points)**

  
Previous exposure to the automotive domain, specifically Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) environments or TraceTronic tools (ECU-TEST, TEST-GUIDE).  

  
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Ansible or Terraform.  

  
Familiarity with monitoring stacks (e.g. Grafana,..) for tracking pipeline health.

title: Product & Infrastructure Security Engineer
details:
**Job Overview**

UltaHost is looking for a Senior Product & Infrastructure Security Engineer to take ownership of the security of our hosting products and the infrastructure that delivers them. This is a deeply technical, hands-on position combining product security, application security, Linux/server security, virtualization, network security, vulnerability management, and DDoS incident response. We are looking for someone who understands security not only from a testing perspective, but from the realities of operating and protecting production hosting infrastructure.

**What You’ll Own**

**Hosting Product & Application Security**

* Review the security of VPS, VDS, dedicated servers, shared hosting, WordPress, cloud, Mac hosting, email hosting, game hosting, customer portals, control panels, APIs, and internal hosting platforms.
* Assess authentication, authorization, session security, tenant isolation, secrets handling, privileged operations, and data-exposure risks.
* Perform threat modeling, architecture reviews, security testing, API security reviews, and release risk assessments.
* Define security requirements and release checks for new products, major features, and sensitive platform changes.
* Work with Product, Engineering, DevOps, and QA teams until vulnerabilities are remediated, retested, and closed.

**Server, Virtualization & Network Security**

* Define secure baselines for Linux servers, hypervisors, control panels, network devices, firewalls, storage systems, and management interfaces.
* Review SSH configurations, exposed ports and services, routing, DNS, firewall rules, segmentation, management access, and privilege boundaries.
* Secure environments involving Proxmox, KVM, VMware, Ceph, containers, VPS nodes, dedicated infrastructure, and data-center connectivity.
* Investigate brute-force attacks, malware, suspicious processes, privilege escalation, lateral movement, data exfiltration, and abnormal traffic.
* Own technical DDoS/DoS response, including traffic analysis, mitigation, provider escalation, evidence collection, and post-incident reviews.

**Vulnerability & Technical Incident Management**

* Run vulnerability scanning, configuration audits, patch-risk assessments, and targeted penetration testing.
* Prioritize vulnerabilities according to actual customer and infrastructure risk.
* Assign remediation owners and deadlines and verify that fixes are effective.
* Lead product and infrastructure security incidents.
* Support internal security incidents when servers, networks, or applications are involved.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in hosting security, infrastructure security, Linux security, network security, product security, cloud security, or a closely related role.
* Advanced Linux administration skills.
* Real-world experience with VPS, dedicated servers, shared hosting, control panels, hypervisors, storage, or large multi-tenant environments.
* Experience with Proxmox, KVM, VMware, Ceph, containers, or equivalent virtualization and cluster technologies.
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VPNs, segmentation, and traffic analysis.
* Hands-on experience detecting and mitigating DDoS attacks.
* Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, API security, authentication, authorization, session security, tenant isolation, secrets management, and secure release practices.
* Experience with vulnerability scanners, penetration-testing tools, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, configuration reviews, tcpdump, Wireshark, and log analysis.
* Ability to investigate compromised servers, malware, brute-force attacks, web attacks, privilege escalation, and abnormal network behavior.

**Preferred Background**

Direct experience in a web hosting company, cloud provider, ISP, CDN, data center, infrastructure vendor, or MSSP is highly preferred. Preferred certifications include OSCP, OSWA, CCNP Security, GIAC, Security+, CISSP, cloud-security certifications, or equivalent practical expertise. Certifications are valuable, but real production experience is more important.

**What Success Looks Like**

You will help us achieve:

* Earlier detection of critical vulnerabilities before release or exploitation
* Faster containment of product, server, network, and DDoS incidents
* Reduction of exposed high-risk services and unsafe configurations
* Reduction of overdue vulnerabilities
* Secure baseline coverage across Linux, virtualization, network, and hosting products
* Stronger product-security reviews and remediation verification
* Prevention of recurring security weaknesses

**Important**

This is not a general penetration-testing position. We need someone who can secure and investigate real production hosting infrastructure not someone whose experience is limited to vulnerability testing and producing penetration-test reports. You will work closely with our Internal Security & Security Operations Engineer and collaborate with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Network, QA, Support, Abuse, and executive management. If Linux, networks, virtualization, hosting infrastructure, product security, and incident response are where you do your best work, we’d like to hear from you.

details:

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.

Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking for a Software QA Engineer to join our Engineering Intelligence team and help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of cloud-delivered engineering applications used by global manufacturers.

You will work with quality engineers, developers, product owners, and engineering domain experts to define and execute end-to-end workflows across SaaS, OnPrem, and High Performance Computing (HPC) environments. The role combines software quality engineering with engineering simulation workflows, cloud technologies, automation, and complex distributed systems.

You will play a key role in ensuring that our applications not only function correctly, but also deliver reliable and credible engineering results.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and execute comprehensive testing: Plan and perform functional, integration, system, exploratory, end-to-end, and performance testing for complex engineering and cloud-delivered applications.
* Validate engineering workflows: Test simulation-driven workflows from model setup and execution through solver behavior and result validation, ensuring both functional correctness and engineering credibility.
* Build test automation: Develop, maintain, and enhance automated test suites using modern frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar technologies to improve regression coverage and release efficiency.
* Test cloud and distributed applications: Validate web-based and cloud-native applications across microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed environments.
* Analyze and troubleshoot quality issues: Investigate failures, defects, performance bottlenecks, and unexpected behaviors; perform root-cause analysis and verify fixes.
* Work with CI/CD and engineering infrastructure: Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and troubleshoot test environments across Windows, Linux, containers, and Kubernetes-based environments.
* Drive quality across the product lifecycle: Collaborate with developers, architects, product owners, and domain experts to define acceptance criteria, identify quality risks, and continuously improve test strategy and coverage.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 5+ years of hands-on software QA/testing experience involving technically complex software, with strong experience in test planning, execution, defect analysis, and validation.
* Strong experience with web/UI test automation using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar frameworks.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux/Unix environments, with strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
* Understanding of microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed applications, with exposure to troubleshooting Kubernetes-based environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in Agile teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with engineering simulation, CAE, CAD, or other scientific/technical software, including understanding of simulation workflows beyond basic tool operation.
* Strong understanding of simulation concepts such as meshing, physics modeling, solver configuration, convergence, numerical stability, and result validation.
* Experience with API testing using tools such as Postman and performance testing using JMeter, Gatling, or similar.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and testing applications deployed in cloud environments.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including debugging applications and test environments in containerized environments.
* Experience testing HPC environments, including Linux clusters, MPI-based workloads, and job schedulers such as Slurm or PBS.
* Experience with performance, scalability, reliability, or security testing of distributed or cloud-based applications.

title: Senior Reliability Engineer
details:
*Asante Gold Corporation ('Asante') is a gold exploration, development and operating company with a high-quality portfolio of mines and projects in Ghana. The Company currently operates the Bibiani and Chirano Gold Mines and is advancing the Kubi Gold Project. Asante is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV: ASE), the Ghana Stock Exchange (GSE: ASG) and the OTCQX Market in the United States (OTCQX: ASGOF).*

*Driven by a vision to become the preferred Tier-1 mining company in West Africa, Asante is committed to building a safe, efficient and responsible mining business that delivers sustainable value to its employees, communities, shareholders and other stakeholders.*

*At Asante, our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing an environment where employees can undertake meaningful work, develop their careers and contribute to the future of mining in Ghana.*

*Our culture is guided by the core values of Safety, Ownership, Teamwork and Continuous Improvement and we seek individuals who demonstrate accountability, integrity, collaboration and a passion for excellence.*

*If you share our ambition and are looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a dynamic and growing organization, we invite suitably qualified candidates to apply for the following position:*

***About This Role***

To lead reliability and asset performance improvement initiatives across both fixed plant and mobile mining equipment. The role develops and implements reliability strategies that maximize equipment availability, improve maintenance effectiveness, reduce total cost of ownership and support the safe and sustainable achievement of production targets.

***Key Responsibilities***

**Reliability Leadership**

* Lead the site's Reliability Engineering function for both fixed and mobile assets.
* Develop and execute asset reliability improvement programs aligned with business objectives.
* Drive a culture of proactive maintenance and defect elimination across the operation.
* Establish reliability standards, procedures, and best practices across all operational areas.

**Reliability Analysis and Performance Management**

* Analyze fleet performance data to identify failure trends and reliability risks.
* Optimize preventive and predictive maintenance programs.
* Support fleet replacement and life-cycle planning decisions.
* Improve Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) and reduce unplanned downtime.
* Develop and optimize maintenance strategies for fixed plant assets
* Analyze equipment performance trends and identify reliability improvement opportunities.
* Ensure critical equipment achieves targeted availability and utilization levels.
* Support shutdown planning and execution activities through reliability reviews and risk assessments

**Maintenance Strategy Optimization**

* Develop and review maintenance tactics using:
* + Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM)
  + Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
  + Failure Reporting, Analysis and Corrective Action Systems (FRACAS)
  + Risk Based Maintenance (RBM)

* Optimize preventive maintenance intervals.
* Develop predictive maintenance frameworks.
* Review OEM maintenance recommendations and adapt them to site operating conditions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce maintenance costs while maintaining asset integrity

***Education, Work Experience & Key Competencies***

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Maintenance related discipline from a recognized institution.
* Minimum of 5 years' experience in a Process Plant as a Mechanical Supervisor, Maintenance Planner, Reliability Engineer, preferably within the mining industry.
* A Sectional Engineer's Certificate of Competency issued by the Mines Inspectorate Division of the Minerals Commission Certificate is desirable.
* Professional Certification in Maintenance Planning and Reliability such as CMRP, CRE is preferable.
* Proficiency in Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) (Pronto / JD Edwards / SAP / Oracle / Ellipse, etc.), asset management principles, and technical knowledge of machinery.
* Knowledge in Continuous Improvement or Business Improvements
* Knowledge in the use of condition-based techniques like: Ultrasound, Thermography, Vibrations, Oil Analysis etc.
* Excellent understanding of mills, crushers, conveyors, pumps, thickeners, tanks, and tailings infrastructure.
* Ability to develop high-quality work packs with safety controls, drawings, and methods.
* Strong communication, organisation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong shutdown management experience.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Project, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Strong knowledge of condition monitoring methods, including vibration analysis and thermography.
* Solid understanding of reliability-centred maintenance and equipment design principles.
* Analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills to support decision-making.
* Root cause analysis
* Failure mode and effect analysis
* Maintenance downtime analysis using MTBF and MTTR
* Ability to work in multi-cultural environment and respect other people values and opinions.

title: Senior Lead Network Engineer - InfiniBand
details:
Overview

Integrant is seeking a Senior Lead Network & Infrastructure Engineer with 14+ years of experience to provide technical leadership in a fast-paced, complex HPC and AI environment. This is a multi-disciplinary senior role: the core is deep network engineering across Ethernet and InfiniBand fabrics, ideally complemented by hands-on experience in high-performance storage and/or Linux systems operations (SysOps). The Senior Lead owns fabric architecture and performance, acts as the highest technical escalation point, and works across engineering, platform, storage, and client teams. Adaptability, ownership, and clear communication are key to success in an environment where network performance is critical.

Responsibilities

* Develop network configurations and architectures
* Operate, maintain, and support Ethernet and InfiniBand networks in a high-performance computing (HPC) and AI environment.
* Perform ongoing maintenance, upgrades, and lifecycle management of network equipment.
* Monitor network health, performance, and capacity to ensure reliable, low-latency data flow.
* Respond to and resolve network and server-related incidents in a timely manner.
* Run hardware diagnostics and coordinate replacement of failing network components.
* Support and maintain Linux-based HPC and AI platforms across a wide range of technologies.
* Collaborate with senior network engineers, software teams, and platform teams on network efficiency, reliability, and security.
* Assist with configuration, deployment, and operational support of InfiniBand and Ethernet fabrics.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, including configuration examples, build guides, and best practices.
* Support on-site staff during hardware updates, card replacements, and infrastructure changes.
* Stay current with advancements in data center networking, HPC interconnects, and AI infrastructure technologies.
* Work within the client ticketing / IT service management system (e.g., TopDesk) to manage incidents and service requests to SLA.
* Build and maintain automation and tooling (scripting, monitoring integrations, infrastructure-as-code) to improve operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with software, platform, storage, and client teams on efficiency, reliability, and security.
* Own the quality of operational documentation: configuration examples, build guides, runbooks, and best practices.
* Lead design reviews and knowledge-sharing.

Work Conditions

Participate in a weekly on-call rotation and respond to network and infrastructure issues after hours when required.

 **Requirements**  

* 14+ years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise or data center-scale networks.
* Experience working in HPC, AI/ML, or performance-sensitive environments.
* Practical experience administering InfiniBand (Mellanox/NVIDIA) and Ethernet (Cumulus, SONiC) networks.
* Strong understanding of data center networking concepts, including servers, storage, and high-speed interconnects.
* Solid knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, including routing and switching fundamentals.
* Installing, monitoring, and maintaining very large-scale data center networks.
* Low-latency, high-bandwidth fabric support and performance tuning for distributed compute and GPU workloads.
* VXLAN/EVPN architectures and routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
* Exposure to communication libraries such as NCCL, UCX, and MPI.
* Network management and monitoring tools: UFM, OpenSM, NetQ, or similar.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve network issues in complex, distributed environments.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.
* Proven ability to work effectively as part of a team and provide operational support.

Preferred (Multi-Skill) Qualifications

* Storage: Hands-on experience with high-performance / parallel storage environments (e.g., Lustre, GPFS/Spectrum Scale, BeeGFS, Ceph, NVMe-oF), including storage networking and I/O performance troubleshooting.
* SysOps / Linux systems: Production Linux systems administration at scale — provisioning, configuration management (Ansible/Salt), kernel/network stack tuning, schedulers (Slurm), containerization.

  
**Benefits**  

* Salary paid in USD
* Six-month career advancing opportunities
* Supportive and friendly work environment
* Premium medical insurance [employee +family]
* English language development courses
* Interest-free loans paid over 2.5 years
* Technical development courses
* Employment referral program
* Premium location in Maadi
* Social insurance

title: Engineering Manager & Supply Chain Development
details:
**Job Title:** Engineering Manager & Supply Chain Development

**Reporting to:** Associate Director Plant Operations

**Location:** 6 October Factory

  

**Role Purpose**

  

Lead the site engineering agenda for capital investment and technical capability development, while providing direct leadership to the Supply Chain Development Manager. The role converts business priorities into safe, compliant, financially sound and operationally sustainable CAPEX and supply chain development solutions. It owns projects from early definition through commissioning, handover and benefits tracking, and integrates manufacturing readiness across innovation, capacity, productivity, cost-out and supply continuity initiatives.

  
  

**IN SCOPE**

* CAPEX portfolio and project delivery
* Engineering design and technical standards
* Supply chain development and commercialization
* Capacity, productivity and continuity projects
* Technical governance and capability building
  

  

**EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE**

* Routine and preventive maintenance
* Breakdown maintenance and daily work orders
* Maintenance labor, spares and workshop management
* Maintenance planning, scheduling and compliance
* Day-to-day equipment reliability ownership
  

  

**Key Accountabilities**

**CAPEX Strategy, Portfolio and Governance**

* Develop and maintain the site capital master plan aligned with business strategy, risk priorities, capacity requirements, compliance needs and productivity targets.
* Build and manage the annual and multi-year CAPEX portfolio, including project prioritization, phasing, resource planning, cash-flow forecasting and governance reporting.
* Prepare robust project charters and business cases covering scope, options, technical feasibility, cost, schedule, risk, expected benefits and implementation approach.
* Operate the applicable capital approval and stage-gate process, ensuring decision-quality documentation, stakeholder alignment and timely escalation of risks or changes.
* Monitor portfolio performance and recommend corrective action where cost, schedule, scope, risk or benefits deviate from approved commitments.
  

  

**Project Development and Delivery**
------------------------------------

* Lead CAPEX projects from concept and feasibility through design, procurement support, installation, commissioning, qualification, start-up and formal handover.
* Define user requirements, engineering deliverables, acceptance criteria and project execution plans in partnership with Operations, FSQ, EHS, Procurement, Finance, R&D and other stakeholders.
* Ensure designs comply with corporate engineering standards, legal requirements, food safety, quality, EHS, sustainability and operational requirements.
* Manage project scope, cost, schedule, quality, risks, contractors and change control, with clear accountability and auditable project records.
* Plan commissioning and start-up readiness, including training, documentation, spare-parts recommendations, operating procedures and post-implementation support.
* Complete project close-out, asset capitalization inputs, lessons learned and benefits validation with Finance and business owners.
  

  

**Supply Chain Development Leadership**
---------------------------------------

* Directly manage, coach and set priorities for the Supply Chain Development Manager, with clear objectives, decision rights and development plans.
* Lead end-to-end technical and supply chain readiness for innovation, renovation, growth, capacity, productivity, cost-out and supply continuity initiatives.
* Ensure factory capabilities, constraints, capacity, minimum order quantities, material requirements, trial plans and launch risks are evaluated during project scoping.
* Coordinate factory trials, technical assessments and manufacturing readiness activities, ensuring decisions and actions are documented and closed before launch.
* Integrate requirements across Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, Logistics, R&D, Marketing, Commercial, Finance, FSQ and EHS to support successful commercialization.
* Identify supply chain impacts and trade-offs, including manufacturing route, network capacity, cost of goods, investment needs, service risk and implementation timing.
* Provide transparent project status, decision needs, risks and mitigation plans to leadership and cross-functional governance forums.
* Support post-launch stabilization and ensure unresolved technical or supply risks transition to accountable business owners.

**Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Sponsor engineering studies and technology assessments that improve capacity, conversion cost, quality, safety, sustainability and manufacturing flexibility.
* Challenge project teams to simplify solutions, eliminate non-value-added scope and optimize total cost of ownership without compromising compliance or performance.
* Apply structured problem solving, value engineering and lessons learned to improve project outcomes and future standards.
* Develop the project management and technical capabilities of engineers and Supply Chain Development resources through coaching, standards and knowledge sharing.
* EHS, Quality, Food Safety and Compliance
* Ensure CAPEX and development activities meet applicable EHS, food safety, quality, environmental, regulatory and corporate requirements.
* Embed risk assessment, management of change, hygienic design, contractor safety and safe-start-up requirements into project execution.
* Participate in audits and governance reviews relevant to engineering projects and commercialization, and ensure assigned corrective actions are completed.
* Stop or escalate work where safety, quality, food safety, legal compliance or asset integrity requirements are not met.

**People and Stakeholder Leadership**
-------------------------------------

* Create an inclusive, accountable and high-performance culture across project and supply chain development teams.
* Set annual objectives, conduct performance and development discussions, plan succession and enable capability building for direct reports.
* Influence senior stakeholders and resolve cross-functional priorities through fact-based recommendations and clear decision framing.
* Manage external engineering partners, contractors, consultants and suppliers in accordance with procurement, EHS and ethical standards.

**Decision Rights**

* Recommend CAPEX priorities, project sequencing and resource allocation within approved governance.
* Approve technical deliverables and project progression within delegated authority and established stage-gate requirements.
* Assign priorities and deliverables to the Supply Chain Development Manager and project resources.
* Escalate, pause or stop project activity when scope, cost, schedule, safety, quality, food safety or compliance thresholds are at risk.
* Recommend make/buy, technology, supplier and manufacturing-route options to the relevant approval authority
  

  

**Key Interfaces**

  

* **Plant Operations:** Business priorities, installation windows, start-up ownership and operational handover
* **Supply Chain Development Manager:** portfolio execution, commercialization readiness, risk management and capability development
* **Finance:** Business cases, investment control, cash flow, capitalization and benefits validation
* **Procurement:** Tendering, commercial strategy, contracting and supplier performance
* **FSQ and EHS:** Design compliance, risk assessments, validation, management of change and safe start-up
* **R&D / Marketing / Commercial:** Innovation scope, technical feasibility, launch readiness and business trade-offs
* **Planning / Logistics:** Capacity, material, network, inventory and service implications
* **External partners:** Engineering design, equipment supply, construction, installation and specialist services
  

  
  

**Success Measures**

* CAPEX delivery against approved scope, budget, schedule, quality and safety commitments.
* Accuracy and timeliness of capital forecasting, governance submissions and project reporting.
* Planned benefits achieved and validated after implementation.
* Successful commissioning, start-up and operational handover with agreed acceptance criteria met.
* Supply chain and manufacturing readiness achieved for approved launches and change initiatives.
* Effective closure of project, compliance and readiness risks before key decision gates.
* Development, engagement and succession readiness of direct reports and assigned project teams.
  

  

Qualifications and Experience

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Chemical, Mechatronics or a related engineering discipline.
* Project management, Lean, Six Sigma or finance-for-non-finance certification is advantageous.

**Experience**
--------------

* Progressive experience in engineering, manufacturing, capital projects or supply chain development within a complex production environment.
* Demonstrated ownership of multidisciplinary CAPEX projects from concept through commissioning and business handover.
* Experience developing business cases, managing project economics and controlling scope, schedule, cost, risk and contractors.
* Experience leading cross-functional commercialization, capacity, productivity or supply continuity initiatives.
* People-management experience, including coaching, objective setting and capability development.
* FMCG, food or other regulated manufacturing experience is preferred.

**Knowledge and Skills**
------------------------

* CAPEX governance, project management, engineering design and commissioning.
* Manufacturing processes, capacity analysis, technical risk assessment and supply chain fundamentals.
* Business-case development, financial analysis, budgeting and benefits tracking.
* EHS, food safety, quality, management of change and contractor-management principles.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, decision-making and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into practical technical and supply chain solutions.
  

  

Leadership Competencies

* Strategic thinking and enterprise perspective.
* Ownership, accountability and bias for action.
* Cross-functional influence and constructive challenge.
* Customer and consumer focus in technical decision-making.
* Developing people and building organizational capability.
* Data-driven problem solving and sound judgment under uncertainty.
* Change leadership, resilience and continuous improvement mindset.

details:

This is an opportunity to shape the identity security posture of regional and global organizations while leading client engagements, managing delivery teams, and contributing to business growth. title: IT-Consultant (m/w/d) – 100% Remote – Deutsch fließend
details:

**Über uns**

hausverwalter.ai ist Software für Hausverwaltungen in Deutschland. Inbox, CRM, Dokumente, Telefonie, Videocalls, Team-Chat und KI-Agenten in einer Plattform, damit Hausverwalter ihre tägliche Arbeit an einem Ort erledigen. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit Sitz in Worms und arbeiten komplett remote. Wir finanzieren uns selbst und sind profitabel.

**Was du bei uns machst**

* **Du planst die Einführung.** Mit dem Kunden legst du fest, was wann umgestellt wird, und sorgst dafür, dass der Zeitplan hält.

* **Du schulst das Team des Kunden.** Per Videocall zeigst du, wie man mit der Software arbeitet, und beantwortest Fragen.

title: Oracle WebLogic Senior Administrator
details:
**Job Description:**

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Oracle WebLogic Administrator with deep expertise in deploying, managing, and optimizing Oracle WebLogic Server and Oracle Fusion Middleware across on-premises and OCI-hosted environments. This role owns the full middleware lifecycle from domain provisioning, clustering, and performance engineering to patching, security hardening, and cloud migration supporting mission-critical Oracle application stacks including E-Business Suite, Siebel CRM, Oracle SOA Suite, Oracle Service Bus (OSB), and Oracle Integration middleware.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**WebLogic Domain Administration**

* Install, configure, and manage Oracle WebLogic Server (12c, 14c) across development, staging, and production environments.
* Design and administer WebLogic domains including Admin Servers, Managed Servers, clusters, machine configurations, and Node Managers.
* Configure and manage JDBC data sources, connection pools, JMS resources (queues, topics, connection factories), and work managers.
* Administer WebLogic security realms authentication providers (LDAP, Active Directory, OAM), authorization policies, SSL/TLS certificates, and keystores.
* Manage WebLogic deployments EAR/WAR/JAR lifecycle, staged/nostage deployments, versioned deployments, and rollback procedures.
Configure coherence clusters, session replication, and distributed caching where applicable.  

  

**Oracle Fusion Middleware Administration**

* Administer Oracle SOA Suite SOA composites, BPEL processes, Mediator, Human Workflow, and Business Rules across SOA clusters.
* Manage Oracle Service Bus (OSB) proxy/business services, message pipelines, transformations, routing rules, and throttling configurations.
* Administer Oracle HTTP Server (OHS), Oracle Traffic Director (OTD), and Oracle Web Cache for web-tier load balancing and request routing.
* Manage Oracle Identity and Access Management (OAM, OIM, OUD, OID) middleware components on WebLogic.
* Administer Oracle Business Intelligence (OBIEE/OAS) and Oracle Forms/Reports middleware deployments.
Manage Oracle Enterprise Manager Fusion Middleware Control (EM FMWC) for monitoring, diagnostics, and configuration management.  

  

**Oracle Application Stack Support**

* Manage WebLogic and Fusion Middleware tiers underpinning **Oracle E-Business Suite** EBS WebLogic domains, Oracle HTTP Server, Forms/Reports services, and concurrent processing infrastructure.
* Administer middleware for **Siebel CRM** Siebel Application Interface (AI), Siebel Gateway, Siebel Server components, and WebLogic-hosted Siebel web services.
* Support **Oracle SOA/OSB/AIA** integration middleware composite deployment, fault management, adapter configurations (DB, File, FTP, JMS, REST), and endpoint lifecycle.
* Manage middleware for **Oracle BRM** BRM web services gateway, custom pipeline integration endpoints, and WebLogic-hosted billing APIs.

  

**High Availability & Disaster Recovery**

* Design and manage WebLogic clustering for horizontal scalability and active-active/active-passive HA topologies.
* Configure and maintain Oracle Global Load Balancer (GLB), Oracle Traffic Director, and hardware/software load balancers (F5, HAProxy) for WebLogic tier.
* Implement WebLogic whole-server migration, service migration, and singleton services for automatic failover.
* Design and execute DR runbooks for WebLogic/FMW environments including cross-site Data Guard integration, rsync-based replication, and OCI-based DR strategies.
Manage and test failover/switchover procedures with documented RTO/RPO alignment.  

  

**Performance Engineering & Tuning**

* Tune JVM parameters (heap sizing, garbage collection G1GC, ZGC), thread pools, work managers, and execute queues for optimal throughput.
* Monitor and optimize WebLogic performance using WLST, WLDF (WebLogic Diagnostic Framework), Flight Recorder, and thread dump analysis.
* Analyze and resolve stuck threads, memory leaks, connection pool exhaustion, and session management issues.
* Conduct capacity planning sizing WebLogic domains, JVM instances, and cluster node counts based on workload profiling.
Integrate with enterprise monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OEM, Datadog) for real-time WebLogic and FMW health observability.  

  

**Patching & Lifecycle Management**

* Plan and execute WebLogic and Fusion Middleware patching (CPU/PSU/RU patches, one-off patches) using OPatch and BSU.
* Manage Oracle Middleware home structures, inventory management, and patch conflict resolution.
* Coordinate patching windows with application and database teams, ensuring rollback readiness.
Execute WebLogic version upgrades (e.g., 12c to 14c) and Fusion Middleware stack upgrades with minimal downtime.  

  

**Cloud Migration & OCI**

* Migrate WebLogic and Fusion Middleware workloads to OCI lift-and-shift to OCI Compute, re-platform to WebLogic for OCI (Marketplace/Terraform), or modernize to OKE.
* Provision and manage WebLogic on OCI using Marketplace images, Terraform stacks, and OCI Resource Manager.
* Administer Oracle WebLogic Suite for OCI, including integration with OCI Load Balancer, OCI DNS, and OCI WAF.
* Evaluate and implement containerization of WebLogic workloads using WebLogic Kubernetes Operator on OKE.
Configure OCI-native monitoring and log aggregation for WebLogic workloads (OCI Logging, Logging Analytics, APM).  

  

**Automation & Tooling**

* Develop and maintain automation using WLST (WebLogic Scripting Tool) for domain creation, configuration, deployment, and monitoring.
* Build Infrastructure as Code for WebLogic provisioning using Terraform and Ansible playbooks.
* Automate routine tasks log rotation, health checks, deployment pipelines, and certificate renewals.
Administer Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) 13c Cloud Control for WebLogic/FMW target monitoring and compliance.  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8–10 years of progressive experience in Oracle middleware administration with deep expertise in Oracle WebLogic Server (12c/14c).
* Expert-level knowledge of WebLogic domain architecture clustering, JMS, JDBC, security realms, Node Manager, and deployment models.
* Strong experience administering Oracle Fusion Middleware: SOA Suite, OSB, OHS, OAM/OIM, and EM FMWC.
* Proven experience supporting WebLogic/FMW tiers for at least two of: Oracle EBS, Siebel CRM, Oracle SOA/OSB/AIA, or Oracle BRM.
* Deep proficiency in JVM tuning (G1GC, ZGC, heap/metaspace sizing) and WebLogic performance diagnostics (WLDF, thread dumps, heap dumps).
* Strong experience with WebLogic patching, upgrade lifecycles, and Oracle Middleware home management.
* Hands-on experience migrating WebLogic workloads to OCI (Compute, Marketplace, OKE).
* Proficiency in WLST scripting and at least one automation language: Python, Bash, or Ansible.
* Working knowledge of Linux system administration (Oracle Linux / RHEL).
* Strong understanding of load balancing, SSL/TLS, DNS, and web-tier architecture.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to produce clear operational documentation and engage with application and client stakeholders.

title: Consultant Healthcare – Commercial Officer
details:
**ORGANIZATION BACKGROUND:**
  
ACCESS Health International (AHI) is a non-profit, think tank, and advisory group with the mission of improving access to high-quality and affordable healthcare for all people. AHI advises national and regional governments and the private sector on the design and management of healthcare finance and delivery systems. Established in 2007, the organization is located in India, Singapore, the MENA Region, and is headquartered in the USA. AHI’s vision is that all people, no matter where they live, and no matter what their age, have a right to access high-quality and affordable healthcare and to lead healthy and productive lives. For more information about AHI, please visit: https://accessh.org/

**JOB DESCRIPTION / RESPONSIBILITIES:**
  
The Consultant Healthcare – Commercial Officer is a senior techno-commercial role responsible for advancing AHI’s strategic priorities in Egypt. Operating from Cairo, the incumbent will cultivate relationships across the full healthcare value chain — from pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturers and distributors to hospitals, clinics, NGOs, and regulatory authorities. The role is weighted approximately 60–70% toward commercial engagement, stakeholder management, and business development, with 30–40% grounded in technical and regulatory understanding of the Egyptian healthcare landscape. The successful candidate will serve as a credible, polished ambassador of the organisation — equally at ease in boardroom discussions, regulatory consultations, and clinical stakeholder settings.

Key Job Responsibilities:

(1) Build and sustain high-value relationships across the Egyptian healthcare ecosystem, including pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturers, licensed distributors, retail pharmacy chains, private hospitals, public health institutions, polyclinics, and international NGOs.

(2) Engage proactively with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), clinical specialists, hospital administrators, and
  
healthcare group executives to position AHI as an authoritative, independent think-tank partner.

(3) Develop and manage relationships with the Egyptian Ministry of Health and Population (MOHP), the Egyptian Drug Authority (EGDA), the Universal Health Insurance Authority, and other relevant regulatory and governmental bodies, supporting policy dialogue and ecosystem initiatives.

(4) Identify, develop, and close strategic partnership, programme, and advisory opportunities aligned with AHI’s non-profit mandate and global health priorities.

(5) Lead business development conversations with institutional clients, industry partners, multinational corporations, and donor organisations — from initial engagement through to formal collaboration agreements.

(6) Represent AHI at Egyptian and regional healthcare conferences, regulatory forums, health summits, and industry roundtables.

(7) Monitor competitive and market intelligence across Egypt and the wider MENA region, identifying trends, white spaces, and partnership opportunities relevant to the organisation’s mission.

(8) Maintain an up-to-date understanding of the Egyptian healthcare regulatory landscape, including MOHP and EGDA frameworks, pharmaceutical and medical device regulations, Universal Health Insurance reforms, and evolving national health strategies (e.g., Egypt Vision 2030 health agenda).

(9) Provide timely regulatory and policy intelligence to internal regional and global teams, translating complex market developments into actionable strategic insight; support development of policy submissions, white papers, and position briefs.

(10) Maintain current CRM records, account plans, and engagement trackers; prepare periodic reports for regional and global leadership.

(11) Collaborate actively with regional and global programme teams on proposal development, knowledge-sharing, and cross-market initiatives.

(12) Undertake regular travel within Egypt and occasional international travel for regional and global programme engagements.

**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, AND COMPETENCIES:**

Qualifications

Minimum requirement — Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy (B.Pharm / Pharm.D); equivalent qualification in Medicine, Biomedical Sciences, Public Health, or a related healthcare discipline will also be considered. An MBA or postgraduate qualification in Healthcare Management, Public Health, or Business Administration is a strong advantage.

  

Experience

10+ years of progressive experience in the Egyptian healthcare sector, with demonstrable exposure to multiple segments of the value chain spanning manufacturers, distributors, and institutional healthcare providers.

(1) Proven track record of engaging with pharmaceutical or medical device manufacturers, distributors, and retail pharmacy chains operating in Egypt.

(2) Hands-on experience working with or selling into private hospitals, multi-specialty clinics, and public healthcare institutions within Egypt.

(3) Documented relationships with the Egyptian Ministry of Health and Population (MOHP), the Egyptian Drug Authority (EGDA), and established KOL networks.

(4) Familiarity with drug and device registration, pricing, and reimbursement frameworks in Egypt, including the Universal Health Insurance scheme, is a significant advantage.

(5) Prior engagement with NGOs, international health organisations, or bilateral/multilateral donor-funded health programmes is a strong plus.

(6) Background in a consultative, advisory, or commercial function — not purely operational or clinical.

Skills and Competencies

(1) Exceptional communication and presentation skills — polished, articulate, and persuasive across diverse cultural and professional settings, equally effective at boardroom, clinical, and community levels.

title: Telecom Maintenance Engineer @Siemens Mobility Egypt
details:
Siemens Mobility (SMO) is the world's leading provider of mobility solutions that enable the efficient, safe, and environmentally friendly transport of people and goods, helping to improve the quality of everyday life for millions worldwide.

Motivated by innovation, we develop intelligent solutions for the growing digitalization of the transport sector. Our offerings include rail vehicles, rail automation, road traffic management systems, rail electrification, and services.

In Egypt, Siemens Mobility is delivering one of the country's first high-speed rail systems. Joining this project could be a pivotal milestone in your career and a significant achievement for the region.

Today, we are recruiting for a **Telecom** **Maintenance Engineer** to join our team in Egypt. This is an excellent career opportunity for professionals who want to join a truly international team on one of the biggest projects of Siemens Mobility.

* Provide technical support for preventive, corrective, and condition-based maintenance of assigned COM systems.
* Diagnose complex faults, investigate recurring failures, and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor asset condition, availability, and reliability, and identify trends and improvement opportunities.
* Review maintenance procedures, work instructions, and technical documentation based on operational findings.

* Assist supervisors and technicians during complex interventions, inspections, testing, and service restoration.
* Maintain accurate technical findings, investigation records, and corrective actions in CMMS and relevant systems.
* Coordinate technical interfaces with MCC, Scheduling, Engineering, Asset Management, IT, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
* Support risk assessments, technical inspections, knowledge transfer, audits, and COM improvement initiatives.
* Provide technical guidance to COM shift supervisors and technicians.
* Provide technical input to forecasts, procurement needs, and improvements.

### **What do I need to qualify for this job?**

* A bachelor's degree in telecommunications, electronics, electrical, computer engineering, or a comparable discipline.
* 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in communications (COM) systems or comparable technical infrastructure maintenance.
* Experience in troubleshooting, fault investigation, and preventive and corrective maintenance.
* A good understanding of network, transmission, and communication equipment, and related maintenance and diagnostic practices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis capabilities.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, system architecture, schematics, and manuals.
* Strong spoken and written English, with effective technical communication.
* Proficiency with CMMS, standard office tools, and relevant technical software.
* Experience with radio and voice communications, transmission networks, station communication, and associated interfaces.
* Familiarity with CMMS, technical documentation, and maintenance reporting.
* Access stations, depots, equipment rooms, and other operational areas, and meet Fitness Class 2 and role-specific medical requirements.

As a world leader in developing and producing the most advanced technologies, we improve lives and further human achievements worldwide, while also protecting the climate. details:

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1759168

EY's people in more than 150 countries are committed to operating with integrity, quality and professionalism in the provision of audit, tax and transaction advisory services. **The opportunity**

  

We are currently seeking an Egyptian National to take the role of Egyptian Data Protection Officer as required by Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law. The successful candidate would join our dynamic team of professionals within the Risk Management function to focus on the rapidly developing Egyptian data protection legal framework and ensure all our own expanding Egyptian member firm’s businesses are compliant. EY MENA’s Data Protection Team straddles our Risk Management and Legal Team and are responsible for the development, implementation and on-going monitoring of the firm’s data risk and regulatory compliance. As an integral part of the data protection team, this individual will be managing the Egyptian member firms’ data protection and become a technical subject matter expert in consulting with, and providing guidance to, our service line professionals. They will also support the wider regional team with their expertise across MENA’s developing and exciting data protection regulatory and confidentiality landscape. This individual will also serve as a role model by promoting and demonstrating our commitment to data protection, data privacy and risk management policies and processes within the organization.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

  

* Informing and advising us and our personnel with respect to our obligations under the Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law and other regional data protection provisions

* Monitoring EY Egypt firm’s compliance with the Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law, the regulations of Ernst & Young Global Limited insofar as they relate to the protection of personal data and any other applicable policies in relation to the protection of personal data, including the assignment of responsibilities, awareness-raising and training of our staff, and conducting and/or arranging for internal audits as appropriate

* Working and cooperating with our designated supervisory authority and serving as the contact point for the supervisory authority on issues relating to the processing of personal data

* Being available to respond to inquiries from data subjects on issues relating to data protection practices and data subjects’ rights, including withdrawal of consent, the right to be forgotten, and related rights.

* Develop and deliver personal data protection training courses and presentations

* Assisting in the developing and monitoring of local procedures for personal data breach handling and being available as a first point of contact to assist with responding to any breaches of personal data, including assessing whether the data breach must be notified to supervisory authorities and/or data subjects

* Contribute to the development of data breach response plans and prepare periodic reports regarding EYactivities related to the processing of personal data

* Keeping up-to-date your in-depth knowledge of the Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law (and any other future variants), including guidance issued by supervisory authorities and relevant legal decisions that may impact our processing of personal data. You are responsible for arranging through EY any necessary subsequent training required under the law

* Notifying EY if you become aware of a conflict between your duties as Egyptian DPO and any additional tasks and duties you fulfil or if those additional tasks and duties

* Lead on the completing and maintaining of ROPA (record of processing activities) for all EY Egypt businessoperations in line with retention policy

* Following up on regulatory documents issued by the competent authority related to the protection ofpersonal data, including any amendments, and inform the relevant departments to ensure compliance

* Providing support and advice to those responsible for developing and operating modern technological systems to ensure compliance with the requirements of the Egyptian Law and its Implementing Regulations

* Provide direct support and advice to EY Egypt partners, briefing them of their responsibilities and ensuring they are compliant to their requirements as leaders of our Egypt member firm

* Assist the EY MENA Region Data Protection team in the monitoring of data handling, client confidentiality, awareness campaigns and data breach response

* Assist the EY MENA Region DPO and Data Privacy Team in conducting privacy assessments and reviews, andimplementation of data privacy regulations across the region. Cooperating with GCO and RM on relevant local, regional and global projects and initiatives

* Assist with preparation for, and coordination of, practice inspections by external regulators and EY’s Global Internal Audit team;

* Manage or participate in other risk management projects as required

* Other duties as assigned.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

* Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to apply conceptual framework tonew and unique situations

* Excellent IT, business writing, communication and presentation skills

* Ability to work in a busy, deadline driven environment and meet unexpected internal, regulatory or clientdemands

* Can work independently, showing initiative to handle multiple tasks simultaneously

* Honesty and integrity having not been convicted or involved in any dishonest incident or breach of trust

* A high level of confidence in dealing and briefing senior executives and challenging situations

  

**To qualify for the role you must have**

  

* 3+ years of experience in a data protection, data privacy or a legal function with data protection experience

* An academic degree, preferably in law, computer science, cyber security or a related field

* Have appropriate credentials and experience in the field of Data Protection

* Experience of operating in a large international or Egyptian business in risk management, data protection, internal compliance or legal function

* Fluent, verbal and written, in English and Arabic

  

**What we look for**

  

Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident leader equipped with strong people management skills and a genuine passion to make things happen in a dynamic organization.

**If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.**

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

At PwC, our people in cybersecurity focus on protecting organisations from cyber threats through advanced technologies and strategies. They work to identify vulnerabilities, develop secure systems, and provide proactive solutions to safeguard sensitive data.
  
  
As a cybersecurity generalist at PwC, you will focus on providing comprehensive security solutions and experience across various domains, maintaining the protection of client systems and data. **About PwC ETIC - Egypt Technology and Innovation Centre**

PwC opened a new Technology & Innovation Center in Cairo that delivers high quality technology solutions to consulting clients across the globe. The Centre provides a broad suite of skills and services to our clients, ranging from Packaged Applications such as SAP & Oracle, to cyber security, data analytics, custom development and cloud services utilizing AWS, Azure and Google, as well as expanding our existing managed services capabilities.

The center is looking to expand rapidly and we are looking for enthusiastic self-starters with a passion for technology and client delivery to help shape and form this new venture.

Cyber security is one of the defining topics of our age, and cyber risk represents one of the most significant strategic risks to PwC’s clients. title: Senior Engineer I, System and Architecture Design
details:

title: Lead SysOps Engineer
details:
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Principal DevOps/SysOps Engineer to join our innovative team. The ideal candidate possesses a strong knowledge in Linux Servers administration, Managing clusters, monitoring tools, containerization (Docker and Kubernetes), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform and Ansible), and scripting languages using Bash and Python. If you are a seasoned professional with a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, we invite you to apply and contribute to our dynamic and collaborative environment.

If you are a passionate and experienced Principal DevOps/SysOps Engineer with a comprehensive skill set, including expertise in Linux, we encourage you to apply and contribute to our cutting-edge projects and initiatives.

Responsibilities:

* Deploy, configure, and maintain Linux and Windows servers across physical and virtual environments.
* Strong knowledge of HPC cluster management, job scheduling systems like SLURM or Run:AI
* Hands on experience of Docker containers and Kubernetes, implementation, administration and optimization within complex large scale environments
* Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer with a focus on CI/CD, containerization, GitOps and cloud technologies.
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash, Python for automation and performance tuning.
* Experience with high-speed interconnects (Infiniband, Ethernet), distributed storage systems, and cluster networking.
* Configure and maintain firewalls, load balancers, and VPNs.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex system and networking issues in large-scale clusters.
* Install and utilize monitoring tools to ensure the health, performance, and security of systems.
* Worked with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or Google) to deploy and manage cloud-based solutions.
* Apply knowledge of cybersecurity best practices to enhance the security posture of systems.
* Utilize infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform and Ansible for efficient and reproducible infrastructure deployment.
* Possess a good understanding of the software development lifecycle to collaborate effectively with development teams.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field with 8+ years of experience.
* Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer with a focus on CI/CD, containerization, and cloud technologies.
* Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with Docker containers and Kubernetes.
* Interaction with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or Google).
* Understanding and application of cybersecurity principles.
* Proficiency in infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform and Ansible.
* Excellent scripting skills in Bash and Python.
* Familiarity with the software development lifecycle.
* Strong knowledge of Linux operating systems.

**Preferred Experience:**

* CKA/CKAD/CKS certification.
* Certifications in relevant DevOps, cloud, and cybersecurity domains.
* Additional scripting languages and automation tool proficiency.
* Active participation in community forums or open-source projects.

* Salary paid in USD
* Six-month career advancing opportunities
* Employee parking space
* Supportive and friendly work environment
* Premium medical insurance [employee +family]
* English language development courses
* Interest-free loans paid over 2.5 years
* Technical development courses

* Employment referral program
* Premium location in Maadi
* Social insurance

title: Junior Microsoft 365 Engineer
details:
**Madar** is a leading Saudi digital logistics platform, owned by Elm transforming transportation management across industries. It connects shippers, carriers, and logistics partners through a unified ecosystem that delivers visibility, efficiency, and automation. Madar enables seamless shipment execution, financial integration, and real-time tracking — redefining the future of logistics in the Kingdom and beyond.

### **About the Role**

We’re looking for a Junior Microsoft 365 Engineer to join our team and help with the day-to-day administration, security, licensing, and user support of our Microsoft 365 tenant (~80 users). You’ll handle routine operations, follow established procedures, and escalate to Microsoft Support or our partners when needed. This is a great opportunity to grow your skills across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.

**Tenant Administration**

* Manage Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive

**Identity & Access**

* Handle the user lifecycle (onboarding to offboarding) in Entra ID

* Help improve Secure Score

**Licensing & Cost**

* Maintain an accurate license inventory and track usage

* Manage mailboxes, distribution lists, mail flow rules, and permissions

* Support migrations and data recovery

**Devices**

* Support Intune (enrollment, compliance, configuration profiles) where applicable

**Operations**

* Provide day-to-day support to users
* Run regular health and security checks
* Automate routine tasks with PowerShell
* Keep documentation up to date and deliver monthly reports

### **How Success Is Measured**

* Users are onboarded and offboarded on time
* Security policies are consistently followed
* License counts are accurate and used efficiently
* No outages caused by missed renewals
* Incidents are resolved quickly
* Security reviews are done regularly
* Documentation and monthly reports are kept current

  
**Requirements**  

### **Requirements**

* 1–2 years of hands-on Microsoft 365 administration or IT support experience
* Foundational experience with Exchange Online administration
* Experience with SharePoint Online administration and permissions
* Basic scripting skills with PowerShell
* Understanding of core IT concepts: networking fundamentals, security best practices, and identity management through Entra ID / Azure AD
